units.title: Society and law
units.intro: Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

ex.zh: 他完成工作几分钟后，就去睡觉了。
ex.p: tā wán chéng gōng zuò jǐ fēn zhōng hòu jiù qù shuì jiào le
ex.en: A few minutes after he finished his work, he went to bed.

ex.zh: 这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。
ex.p: zhè xiē lǜ yè dào qiū tiān biàn chéng hóng sè huò huáng sè
ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.

ex.zh: 你能稍微告诉我关于自己的事情吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng shāo wēi gào sù wǒ guān yú zì jǐ de shì qing ma
ex.en: Can you tell me a little about yourself?

ex.zh: 对于这份工作来说，我的年龄太老了。
ex.p: duì yú zhè fèn gōng zuò lái shuō wǒ de nián líng tài lǎo le
ex.en: I'm getting too old for this job.

ex.zh: “你什么时候回来呀？”“看一下天气怎么样再说啦。”
ex.p: nǐ shén me shí hou huí lai ya kàn yī xià tiān qì zěn me yàng zài shuō lā
ex.en: "When will you be back?" "It all depends on the weather."

ex.zh: 你把我当什么啦？
ex.p: nǐ bǎ wǒ dāng shén me lā
ex.en: Who do you think I am?

ex.zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。
ex.p: hěn bào qiàn wǒ men bù néng jiē shòu nǐ de yāo qiú
ex.en: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.

ex.zh: 他们要求马上把国王处死。
ex.p: tā men yāo qiú mǎ shàng bǎ guó wáng chù sǐ
ex.en: They demanded the king be put to death at once.

ex.zh: 我枪杀了那匹马，因为他已呼吸困难。
ex.p: wǒ qiāng shā le nà pǐ mǎ yīn wèi tā yǐ hū xī kùn nan
ex.en: I shot the horse because it had trouble breathing.

ex.zh: 这就是那个作家自杀的房间。
ex.p: zhè jiù shì nà gè zuò jiā zì shā de fáng jiān
ex.en: This is the room where the author killed himself.

ex.zh: “你去日本干嘛？”“去东京参加一个会议。”
ex.p: nǐ qù rì běn gàn má qù dōng jīng cān jiā yī gè huì yì
ex.en: "Why are you going to Japan?" "To attend a conference in Tokyo."

ex.zh: 你要告诉我你到底想让我干嘛。
ex.p: nǐ yào gào sù wǒ nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng ràng wǒ gàn má
ex.en: You need to tell me what you want me to do.

ex.zh: 哪个更好，红线呢还是白线？
ex.p: nǎ gè gēng hǎo hóng xiàn ne hái shi bái xiàn
ex.en: Which is better, red thread or white thread?

ex.zh: 我可以借用您的眼线笔吗？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ jiè yòng nín de yǎn xiàn bǐ ma
ex.en: Could I borrow your eyeliner?

ex.zh: 一些疾病的产生原因是基因缺陷。
ex.p: yī xiē jí bìng de chǎn shēng yuán yīn shì jī yīn quē xiàn
ex.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.

ex.zh: 他因为没有被邀请而气得快疯了。
ex.p: tā yīn wèi méi yǒu bèi yāo qǐng ér qì de kuài fēng le
ex.en: He was mad because he was not invited.

ex.zh: 我没有特别的理由去做。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu tè bié de lǐ yóu qù zuò
ex.en: I have no particular reason to do so.

ex.zh: 没发生什么特别的事。
ex.p: méi fā shēng shén me tè bié de shì
ex.en: Nothing special happened.

ex.zh: 下次去邮局的时候，请把这封信寄出去。
ex.p: xià cì qù yóu jú de shí hou qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jì chū qù
ex.en: Please mail this letter the next time you go to the post office.

ex.zh: 我改了一下我的网站的布局。
ex.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ de wǎng zhàn de bù jú
ex.en: I've changed my website's layout.

ex.zh: 他昨晚都在工作，彻夜未眠。
ex.p: tā zuó wǎn dōu zài gōng zuò chè yè wèi mián
ex.en: He worked last night without taking a break.

ex.zh: 我们有许多未完成的事。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu xǔ duō wèi wán chéng de shì
ex.en: We have so many things left to do.

items.en: Wow!; sound of a child's crying

ex.zh: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。
ex.p: yī bēi lěng shuǐ zài shǔ rè de tiān qì lǐ shí fēn tí shén
ex.en: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.

ex.zh: 我是无神论者。
ex.p: wǒ shì wú shén lùn zhě
ex.en: I'm an atheist.

ex.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。
ex.p: wǒ men cháng bǎ hēi sè gēn sǐ wáng lián xì qǐ lai
ex.en: We often associate black with death.

ex.zh: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。
ex.p: jiāo tōng shì gù shì měi guó qīng shào nián sǐ wáng de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
ex.en: Car accidents are the leading cause of death for teenagers in the United States.

ex.zh: 你必须遵守规则。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zūn shǒu guī zé
ex.en: You have to follow the rules.

ex.zh: 你能帮我说明一下规则吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ shuō míng yī xià guī zé ma
ex.en: Will you explain the rule to me?

items.en: (of water etc) clear; clean; quiet; still

ex.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā shì qīng bái de nà tā qī zǐ jiù yǒu zuì
ex.en: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.

ex.zh: 我的爷爷喜欢大清早的散步。
ex.p: wǒ de yé ye xǐ huan dà qīng zǎo de sàn bù
ex.en: My grandfather is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.

ex.zh: 我觉得一般滑板比轮滑鞋便宜。
ex.p: wǒ jué de yī bān huá bǎn bǐ lún huá xié pián yi
ex.en: I think skateboards are usually cheaper than rollerblades.

ex.zh: 轮到他时，我们故意跳过了他。
ex.p: lún dào tā shí wǒ men gù yì tiào guò le tā
ex.en: We skipped his turn on purpose.

items.en: to force (sb to do sth); to compel

ex.zh: 我们被逼得走投无路了。
ex.p: wǒ men bèi bī de zǒu tóu wú lù le
ex.en: We were driven to the wall.

items.en: to the greatest extent; furthest or extreme

ex.zh: 尽管受了伤，他们还是继续战斗。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn shòu le shāng tā men hái shi jì xù zhàn dòu
ex.en: Though wounded, they continued to fight.

ex.zh: 他的分数总比我高，尽管他学习得少一点。
ex.p: tā de fēn shù zǒng bǐ wǒ gāo jǐn guǎn tā xué xí de shǎo yī diǎn
ex.en: His scores are always better than mine, even though he doesn't study very much.

ex.zh: 外国投资者从美国收回他们的钱。
ex.p: wài guó tóu zī zhě cóng měi guó shōu huí tā men de qián
ex.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.

ex.zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。
ex.p: tā néng hěn zhǔn què de píng gū tóu zī
ex.en: She can assess investments very accurately.

ex.zh: 为什么这世界上还有战争？
ex.p: wèi shén me zhè shì jiè shàng hái yǒu zhàn zhēng
ex.en: Why are there still wars in the world?

ex.zh: 战争不会使任何人幸福。
ex.p: zhàn zhēng bù huì shǐ rèn hé rén xìng fú
ex.en: War doesn't make anybody happy.

ex.zh: 我们星期五傍晚在我们的地盘开派对。
ex.p: wǒ men xīng qī wǔ bàng wǎn zài wǒ men de de pán kāi pài duì
ex.en: We're throwing a party Friday evening at our place.

ex.zh: 她把脏盘子放进水池里。
ex.p: tā bǎ zāng pán zi fàng jìn shuǐ chí lǐ
ex.en: She put the dirty dishes in the sink.

ex.zh: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。
ex.p: cóng yuè qiú shàng kàn de huà dì qiú kàn qǐ lai xiàng gè pí qiú
ex.en: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.

ex.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
ex.p: rén zào pí gé shì bǐ bù shàng zhēn pí de
ex.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.

ex.zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒu qiāng zhǐ xiàng le mù biāo
ex.en: I aimed my gun at the target.

ex.zh: 我的一位朋友被枪杀。
ex.p: wǒ de yī wèi péng you bèi qiāng shā
ex.en: My friend was shot.

ex.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想一个人呆着。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù jiè yì de huà wǒ xiǎng yī gè rén dāi zhe
ex.en: I'd like to be alone if you don't mind.

ex.zh: 我被他英语的快速进步惊呆了。
ex.p: wǒ bèi tā yīng yǔ de kuài sù jìn bù jīng dāi le
ex.en: I'm amazed at his rapid progress in English.

ex.zh: 为什么没人来我的网站呢？
ex.p: wèi shén me méi rén lái wǒ de wǎng zhàn ne
ex.en: Why is no one visiting my website?

ex.zh: 他既会打网球，又会打棒球。
ex.p: tā jì huì dǎ wǎng qiú yòu huì dǎ bàng qiú
ex.en: He can play both tennis and baseball.

items.en: thunder; (military) mine, as in 雷 land mine

ex.zh: 这艘船没有雷达装备。
ex.p: zhè sōu chuán méi yǒu léi dá zhuāng bèi
ex.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.

ex.zh: 检察官问了我一个引导性的问题。
ex.p: jiǎn chá guān wèn le wǒ yī gè yǐn dǎo xìng de wèn tí
ex.en: The prosecutor asked me a leading question.

ex.zh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。
ex.p: tā shì měi guó dà shǐ guǎn de wài jiāo guān
ex.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.

items.en: open; overt; public; to make public; to release

ex.zh: 恐怕他永远也不会承认自己的罪行。
ex.p: kǒng pà tā yǒng yuǎn yě bù huì chéng rèn zì jǐ de zuì xíng
ex.en: I'm afraid he will never admit his guilt.

ex.zh: 那个男人最终供认了他的罪行。
ex.p: nà gè nán rén zuì zhōng gōng rèn le tā de zuì xíng
ex.en: The man finally confessed.

ex.zh: 我们研究了政府的经济政策。
ex.p: wǒ men yán jiū le zhèng fǔ de jīng jì zhèng cè
ex.en: We studied the government's economic policy.

ex.zh: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。
ex.p: jǐn guǎn zhèng fǔ jù jué chéng rèn tā de jīng jì zhèng cè hái shi shī bài le
ex.en: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.

ex.zh: 你能告诉我能在哪里上公交车吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng gào sù wǒ néng zài nǎ lǐ shàng gōng jiāo chē ma
ex.en: Could you tell me where I can get a bus?

ex.zh: 我们想乘明天早上第一班公交车。
ex.p: wǒ men xiǎng chéng míng tiān zǎo shang dì yī bān gōng jiāo chē
ex.en: We want to be on the first bus tomorrow morning.

ex.zh: 我是世界公民。
ex.p: wǒ shì shì jiè gōng mín
ex.en: I'm a citizen of the world.

ex.zh: 我不想在恐惧中生活。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài kǒng jù zhōng shēng huó
ex.en: I don't want to live my life in fear.

ex.zh: 我不会表现出恐惧。
ex.p: wǒ bù huì biǎo xiàn chū kǒng jù
ex.en: I'm not going to show any fear.

ex.zh: 我为这家报社工作四年了。
ex.p: wǒ wèi zhè jiā bào shè gōng zuò sì nián le
ex.en: I've been working for this newspaper for four years.

ex.zh: 你参加社团活动吗？
ex.p: nǐ cān jiā shè tuán huó dòng ma
ex.en: Do you take part in any community activities?

ex.zh: 这是官方消息。
ex.p: zhè shì guān fāng xiāo xi
ex.en: This news is official.

ex.zh: 她在吃东西比赛里得了一等奖。
ex.p: tā zài chī dōng xi bǐ sài lǐ dé le yī děng jiǎng
ex.en: She got first prize in the eating contest.

ex.zh: 我们的朋友完成了比赛，得了第二名。
ex.p: wǒ men de péng you wán chéng le bǐ sài dé le dì èr míng
ex.en: Our friend finished the race in second place.

ex.zh: 正义终将胜利。
ex.p: zhèng yì zhōng jiāng shèng lì
ex.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

ex.zh: 一些疾病的产生原因是基因缺陷。
ex.p: yī xiē jí bìng de chǎn shēng yuán yīn shì jī yīn quē xiàn
ex.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.

ex.zh: 如果你发现错误，那就请你纠正它。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ fā xiàn cuò wù nà jiù qǐng nǐ jiū zhèng tā
ex.en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.

items.en: public good; public welfare; public interest

ex.zh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
ex.p: jīn wǎn de yè kōng xīng guāng fēi cháng míng liàng
ex.en: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第103单元

Society and law

Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.

sents.zh: 他因为没有被邀请而气得快疯了。
sents.p: tā yīn wèi méi yǒu bèi yāo qǐng ér qì de kuài fēng le
sents.en: He was mad because he was not invited.

sents.zh: 我没有特别的理由去做。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu tè bié de lǐ yóu qù zuò
sents.en: I have no particular reason to do so.

sents.zh: 没发生什么特别的事。
sents.p: méi fā shēng shén me tè bié de shì
sents.en: Nothing special happened.

sents.zh: 下次去邮局的时候，请把这封信寄出去。
sents.p: xià cì qù yóu jú de shí hou qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jì chū qù
sents.en: Please mail this letter the next time you go to the post office.

sents.zh: 我改了一下我的网站的布局。
sents.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ de wǎng zhàn de bù jú
sents.en: I've changed my website's layout.

sents.zh: 他昨晚都在工作，彻夜未眠。
sents.p: tā zuó wǎn dōu zài gōng zuò chè yè wèi mián
sents.en: He worked last night without taking a break.

sents.zh: 我们有许多未完成的事。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu xǔ duō wèi wán chéng de shì
sents.en: We have so many things left to do.

sents.zh: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。
sents.p: yī bēi lěng shuǐ zài shǔ rè de tiān qì lǐ shí fēn tí shén
sents.en: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.

sents.zh: 我是无神论者。
sents.p: wǒ shì wú shén lùn zhě
sents.en: I'm an atheist.

sents.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。
sents.p: wǒ men cháng bǎ hēi sè gēn sǐ wáng lián xì qǐ lai
sents.en: We often associate black with death.

sents.zh: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。
sents.p: jiāo tōng shì gù shì měi guó qīng shào nián sǐ wáng de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
sents.en: Car accidents are the leading cause of death for teenagers in the United States.

sents.zh: 你必须遵守规则。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū zūn shǒu guī zé
sents.en: You have to follow the rules.

sents.zh: 你能帮我说明一下规则吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ shuō míng yī xià guī zé ma
sents.en: Will you explain the rule to me?

sents.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
sents.p: rú guǒ tā shì qīng bái de nà tā qī zǐ jiù yǒu zuì
sents.en: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.

sents.zh: 我的爷爷喜欢大清早的散步。
sents.p: wǒ de yé ye xǐ huan dà qīng zǎo de sàn bù
sents.en: My grandfather is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.

sents.zh: 我觉得一般滑板比轮滑鞋便宜。
sents.p: wǒ jué de yī bān huá bǎn bǐ lún huá xié pián yi
sents.en: I think skateboards are usually cheaper than rollerblades.

sents.zh: 轮到他时，我们故意跳过了他。
sents.p: lún dào tā shí wǒ men gù yì tiào guò le tā
sents.en: We skipped his turn on purpose.

sents.zh: 我们被逼得走投无路了。
sents.p: wǒ men bèi bī de zǒu tóu wú lù le
sents.en: We were driven to the wall.

sents.zh: 尽管受了伤，他们还是继续战斗。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn shòu le shāng tā men hái shi jì xù zhàn dòu
sents.en: Though wounded, they continued to fight.

sents.zh: 他的分数总比我高，尽管他学习得少一点。
sents.p: tā de fēn shù zǒng bǐ wǒ gāo jǐn guǎn tā xué xí de shǎo yī diǎn
sents.en: His scores are always better than mine, even though he doesn't study very much.

sents.zh: 外国投资者从美国收回他们的钱。
sents.p: wài guó tóu zī zhě cóng měi guó shōu huí tā men de qián
sents.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.

sents.zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。
sents.p: tā néng hěn zhǔn què de píng gū tóu zī
sents.en: She can assess investments very accurately.

sents.zh: 为什么这世界上还有战争？
sents.p: wèi shén me zhè shì jiè shàng hái yǒu zhàn zhēng
sents.en: Why are there still wars in the world?

sents.zh: 战争不会使任何人幸福。
sents.p: zhàn zhēng bù huì shǐ rèn hé rén xìng fú
sents.en: War doesn't make anybody happy.

sents.zh: 我们星期五傍晚在我们的地盘开派对。
sents.p: wǒ men xīng qī wǔ bàng wǎn zài wǒ men de de pán kāi pài duì
sents.en: We're throwing a party Friday evening at our place.

sents.zh: 她把脏盘子放进水池里。
sents.p: tā bǎ zāng pán zi fàng jìn shuǐ chí lǐ
sents.en: She put the dirty dishes in the sink.

sents.zh: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。
sents.p: cóng yuè qiú shàng kàn de huà dì qiú kàn qǐ lai xiàng gè pí qiú
sents.en: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.

sents.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
sents.p: rén zào pí gé shì bǐ bù shàng zhēn pí de
sents.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.

sents.zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒu qiāng zhǐ xiàng le mù biāo
sents.en: I aimed my gun at the target.

sents.zh: 我的一位朋友被枪杀。
sents.p: wǒ de yī wèi péng you bèi qiāng shā
sents.en: My friend was shot.

sents.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想一个人呆着。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù jiè yì de huà wǒ xiǎng yī gè rén dāi zhe
sents.en: I'd like to be alone if you don't mind.

sents.zh: 我被他英语的快速进步惊呆了。
sents.p: wǒ bèi tā yīng yǔ de kuài sù jìn bù jīng dāi le
sents.en: I'm amazed at his rapid progress in English.

sents.zh: 为什么没人来我的网站呢？
sents.p: wèi shén me méi rén lái wǒ de wǎng zhàn ne
sents.en: Why is no one visiting my website?

sents.zh: 他既会打网球，又会打棒球。
sents.p: tā jì huì dǎ wǎng qiú yòu huì dǎ bàng qiú
sents.en: He can play both tennis and baseball.

sents.zh: 这艘船没有雷达装备。
sents.p: zhè sōu chuán méi yǒu léi dá zhuāng bèi
sents.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.

sents.zh: 检察官问了我一个引导性的问题。
sents.p: jiǎn chá guān wèn le wǒ yī gè yǐn dǎo xìng de wèn tí
sents.en: The prosecutor asked me a leading question.

sents.zh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。
sents.p: tā shì měi guó dà shǐ guǎn de wài jiāo guān
sents.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.

sents.zh: 恐怕他永远也不会承认自己的罪行。
sents.p: kǒng pà tā yǒng yuǎn yě bù huì chéng rèn zì jǐ de zuì xíng
sents.en: I'm afraid he will never admit his guilt.

sents.zh: 那个男人最终供认了他的罪行。
sents.p: nà gè nán rén zuì zhōng gōng rèn le tā de zuì xíng
sents.en: The man finally confessed.

sents.zh: 我们研究了政府的经济政策。
sents.p: wǒ men yán jiū le zhèng fǔ de jīng jì zhèng cè
sents.en: We studied the government's economic policy.

sents.zh: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn zhèng fǔ jù jué chéng rèn tā de jīng jì zhèng cè hái shi shī bài le
sents.en: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.

sents.zh: 你能告诉我能在哪里上公交车吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng gào sù wǒ néng zài nǎ lǐ shàng gōng jiāo chē ma
sents.en: Could you tell me where I can get a bus?

sents.zh: 我们想乘明天早上第一班公交车。
sents.p: wǒ men xiǎng chéng míng tiān zǎo shang dì yī bān gōng jiāo chē
sents.en: We want to be on the first bus tomorrow morning.

sents.zh: 我是世界公民。
sents.p: wǒ shì shì jiè gōng mín
sents.en: I'm a citizen of the world.

sents.zh: 我不想在恐惧中生活。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài kǒng jù zhōng shēng huó
sents.en: I don't want to live my life in fear.

sents.zh: 我不会表现出恐惧。
sents.p: wǒ bù huì biǎo xiàn chū kǒng jù
sents.en: I'm not going to show any fear.

sents.zh: 我为这家报社工作四年了。
sents.p: wǒ wèi zhè jiā bào shè gōng zuò sì nián le
sents.en: I've been working for this newspaper for four years.

sents.zh: 你参加社团活动吗？
sents.p: nǐ cān jiā shè tuán huó dòng ma
sents.en: Do you take part in any community activities?

sents.zh: 这是官方消息。
sents.p: zhè shì guān fāng xiāo xi
sents.en: This news is official.

sents.zh: 她在吃东西比赛里得了一等奖。
sents.p: tā zài chī dōng xi bǐ sài lǐ dé le yī děng jiǎng
sents.en: She got first prize in the eating contest.

sents.zh: 我们的朋友完成了比赛，得了第二名。
sents.p: wǒ men de péng you wán chéng le bǐ sài dé le dì èr míng
sents.en: Our friend finished the race in second place.

sents.zh: 正义终将胜利。
sents.p: zhèng yì zhōng jiāng shèng lì
sents.en: Justice will prevail in the end.

sents.zh: 如果你发现错误，那就请你纠正它。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ fā xiàn cuò wù nà jiù qǐng nǐ jiū zhèng tā
sents.en: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.

sents.zh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
sents.p: jīn wǎn de yè kōng xīng guāng fēi cháng míng liàng
sents.en: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.

units.title: Society and law
units.intro: Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

ex.zh: 耐心有时候是最有效的武器。
ex.p: nài xīn yǒu shí hou shì zuì yǒu xiào de wǔ qì
ex.en: Patience is sometimes the most effective weapon.

ex.zh: 把你的武器放下。
ex.p: bǎ nǐ de wǔ qì fàng xià
ex.en: Put your weapon down.

ex.zh: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。
ex.p: tā yòng qiān bǐ zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī gè juān
ex.en: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.

ex.zh: 我每个星期日礼拜完都买甜甜圈。
ex.p: wǒ měi gè xīng qī rì lǐ bài wán dōu mǎi tián tián juān
ex.en: I buy donuts every Sunday after church.

ex.zh: 她上飞机前，给我招了招手。
ex.p: tā shàng fēi jī qián gěi wǒ zhāo le zhāo shǒu
ex.en: She waved at me before she got on board the plane.

ex.zh: 失物招领处在哪儿？
ex.p: shī wù zhāo lǐng chǔ zài nǎr
ex.en: Where is the lost and found?

ex.zh: 一个正确的科学家不会那样想。
ex.p: yī gè zhèng què de kē xué jiā bù huì nà yàng xiǎng
ex.en: A true scientist wouldn't think like that.

ex.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。
ex.p: zhè jǐ nián kē xué qǔ dé le xiǎn zhù de jìn bù
ex.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.

ex.zh: 中国的版图大概是日本的二十五倍。
ex.p: zhōng guó de bǎn tú dà gài shì rì běn de èr shí wǔ bèi
ex.en: China has about 25 times the area of Japan.

ex.zh: 我听过这首歌的法语版。
ex.p: wǒ tīng guò zhè shǒu gē de fǎ yǔ bǎn
ex.en: I heard the song sung in French.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢没有英雄的小说。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan méi yǒu yīng xióng de xiǎo shuō
ex.en: I don't like novels without heroes.

ex.zh: 他梦想着成为一名英雄。
ex.p: tā mèng xiǎng zhe chéng wéi yī míng yīng xióng
ex.en: He dreamed of being a hero.

ex.zh: 发言人的评论极有攻击性。
ex.p: fā yán rén de píng lùn jí yǒu gōng jī xìng
ex.en: The speaker's comments were highly offensive.

ex.zh: 敌人对我们发起了攻击。
ex.p: dí rén duì wǒ men fā qǐ le gōng jī
ex.en: The enemy launched an attack on us.

ex.zh: 我不想在城镇的那个地方买房
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài chéng zhèn de nà gè dì fāng mǎi fáng
ex.en: I wouldn't buy a house in that part of town.

ex.zh: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。
ex.p: qì chē wěi qì zài chéng zhèn lǐ zào chéng le yán zhòng de wū rǎn
ex.en: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.

ex.zh: 我注意到她当时戴了顶新帽子。
ex.p: wǒ zhù yì dào tā dāng shí dài le dǐng xīn mào zi
ex.en: I noticed she was wearing a new hat.

ex.zh: 我看见一架直升飞机在头顶飞。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī jià zhí shēng fēi jī zài tóu dǐng fēi
ex.en: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.

ex.zh: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi wǒ méi fàn rèn hé yán zhòng de cuò wù
ex.en: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.

ex.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。
ex.p: fàn zuì xiàn chǎng yǒu sān míng chuān zhì fú de jǐng chá
ex.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.

ex.zh: 她的衣服全部都是她自己做的。
ex.p: tā de yī fu quán bù dōu shì tā zì jǐ zuò de
ex.en: She makes all her own clothes.

ex.zh: 我把钱都花在衣服、食物和书籍上了。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ qián dōu huā zài yī fu shí wù hé shū jí shàng le
ex.en: I spent my money on clothes, food and books.

ex.zh: 布什继里根之后当上了总统。
ex.p: bù shén jì lǐ gēn zhī hòu dāng shàng le zǒng tǒng
ex.en: Bush followed Reagan as president.

ex.zh: 老师给我们布置了家庭作业。
ex.p: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men bù zhì le jiā tíng zuò yè
ex.en: The teacher gave us homework.

ex.zh: 不要再假装一切都好了，不是这样的！
ex.p: bù yào zài jiǎ zhuāng yī qiè dōu hǎo le bù shì zhè yàng de
ex.en: Stop pretending that everything's okay. It's not.

ex.zh: 听到这样的消息我真的很难过。
ex.p: tīng dào zhè yàng de xiāo xi wǒ zhēn de hěn nán guò
ex.en: I'm really sorry to hear that.

ex.zh: 我理所当然地觉得，他会通过考试。
ex.p: wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán de jué de tā huì tōng guò kǎo shì
ex.en: I took it for granted that he would pass the exam.

ex.zh: 你很快就会习惯吃日本料理了。
ex.p: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn chī rì běn liào lǐ le
ex.en: You'll soon get used to Japanese food.

ex.zh: 他们一定很恨我。
ex.p: tā men yī dìng hěn hèn wǒ
ex.en: They must really hate me.

ex.zh: 你为什么恨我？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me hèn wǒ
ex.en: Why do you hate me?

ex.zh: 虽然有阳光照射，但还是很冷。
ex.p: suī rán yǒu yáng guāng zhào shè dàn hái shi hěn lěng
ex.en: The sun was shining, yet it was cold.

ex.zh: 今年的时尚潮流完全不同于去年。
ex.p: jīn nián de shí shàng cháo liú wán quán bù tóng yú qù nián
ex.en: This year's fashions are completely different from last year's.

ex.zh: 跟上最近潮流时尚是件非常花钱的事儿。
ex.p: gēn shàng zuì jìn cháo liú shí shàng shì jiàn fēi cháng huā qián de shì ér
ex.en: It is very expensive to keep up with the latest fashions.

ex.zh: 他以优异的成绩毕业于剑桥大学。
ex.p: tā yǐ yōu yì de chéng jì bì yè yú jiàn qiáo dà xué
ex.en: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.

ex.zh: 没有什么和和平一样重要。
ex.p: méi yǒu shén me hé hé píng yī yàng zhòng yào
ex.en: Nothing's as important as peace.

ex.zh: 整个世界都需要和平。
ex.p: zhěng gè shì jiè dōu xū yào hé píng
ex.en: The entire world desires peace.

ex.zh: 当汽车爆炸时，车上只有三名乘客。
ex.p: dāng qì chē bào zhà shí chē shàng zhǐ yǒu sān míng chéng kè
ex.en: There were only three passengers on the bus when it exploded.

ex.zh: 很多人在随后的爆炸中死去。
ex.p: hěn duō rén zài suí hòu de bào zhà zhōng sǐ qù
ex.en: The explosion that followed killed many people.

ex.zh: 那个时候，没有人在这个岛上生活。
ex.p: nà gè shí hou méi yǒu rén zài zhè gè dǎo shàng shēng huó
ex.en: No one lived on the island at that time.

ex.zh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。
ex.p: zhè gè dǎo shì hái zi men de tiān táng
ex.en: The island is a paradise for children.

items.en: to fight; to engage in combat

ex.zh: 这是战斗发生的地方。
ex.p: zhè shì zhàn dòu fā shēng de dì fāng
ex.en: This is the place where the battle took place.

ex.zh: 像男人一样战斗！
ex.p: xiàng nán rén yī yàng zhàn dòu
ex.en: Fight like a man!

ex.zh: 我不喜欢把生意和快乐混在一起。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan bǎ shēng yì hé kuài lè hún zài yī qǐ
ex.en: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.

ex.zh: 众所周知，空气是多种气体的混合体。
ex.p: zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī kōng qì shì duō zhǒng qì tǐ de hùn hé tǐ
ex.en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.

ex.zh: 别把人家当傻瓜。
ex.p: bié bǎ rén jiā dāng shǎ guā
ex.en: Don't make a fool of me.

ex.zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。
ex.p: fǎng kè tōng cháng zài jìn rù yī hù rì běn rén jiā zhī qián huì bèi yāo qiú tuō xié
ex.en: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.

ex.zh: 我已经头疼三天了，还没摆脱它。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng tóu téng sān tiān le hái méi bǎi tuō tā
ex.en: I've had a headache for three days and I can't get rid of it.

ex.zh: 大好的前途摆在他面前。
ex.p: dà hǎo de qián tú bǎi zài tā miàn qián
ex.en: A brilliant future lay before him.

ex.zh: 猴子跳到他身上的时候，他受到了惊吓。
ex.p: hóu zi tiào dào tā shēn shang de shí hou tā shòu dào le jīng hè
ex.en: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.

ex.zh: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。
ex.p: wǒ zǒng jué de mù ǒu xì yǒu diǎn xià rén
ex.en: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.

ex.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
ex.p: rì běn jūn duì kàn lai qiáng dà de bù kě zǔ dǎng
ex.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.

ex.zh: 军队占领了整片领土。
ex.p: jūn duì zhàn lǐng le zhěng piàn lǐng tǔ
ex.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

ex.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi duì rén shǐ yòng jī yīn biān jí ma
ex.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

ex.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。
ex.p: wǒ biān yì zhè gè chéng xù yǒu xiē kùn nan
ex.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.

ex.zh: 她照顾可怜的小鸟。
ex.p: tā zhào gu kě lián de xiǎo niǎo
ex.en: She took care of the poor little bird.

ex.zh: 这个可怜的年轻人最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。
ex.p: zhè gè kě lián de nián qīng rén zuì hòu chéng wéi le yī gè liǎo bù qǐ de yì shù jiā
ex.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.

ex.zh: 你为何想当一个老师？
ex.p: nǐ wèi hé xiǎng dāng yī gè lǎo shī
ex.en: Why did you want to become a teacher?

items.en: to explode or burst; to quick fry or quick boil

ex.zh: 不知道第三次世界大战会不会爆发。
ex.p: bù zhī dào dì sān cì shì jiè dà zhàn huì bù huì bào fā
ex.en: I wonder if a third world war will break out.

ex.zh: 在全体职员回家后，火事爆发了。
ex.p: zài quán tǐ zhí yuán huí jiā hòu huǒ shì bào fā le
ex.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.

ex.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请谨防食物中毒。
ex.p: yīn wèi kù shǔ yī zhí chí xù zhe qǐng jǐn fáng shí wù zhòng dú
ex.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.

ex.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请务必注意食物中毒。
ex.p: yīn wèi kù shǔ yī zhí chí xù zhe qǐng wù bì zhù yì shí wù zhòng dú
ex.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.

ex.zh: 你知道中央情报局的什么？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de shén me
ex.en: What do you know about the CIA?

ex.zh: 图书馆位于市中央。
ex.p: tú shū guǎn wèi yú shì zhōng yāng
ex.en: The library is in the middle of the city.

ex.zh: 您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？
ex.p: nín néng wèi wǒ jiě shì zhè jù jù zi de yì si ma
ex.en: Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?

ex.zh: 我认为我们刚开始了解这个问题。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi wǒ men gāng kāi shǐ liǎo jiě zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: I think we're just beginning to understand the problem.

ex.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。
ex.p: zhè jǐ nián kē xué qǔ dé le xiǎn zhù de jìn bù
ex.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.

ex.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
ex.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
ex.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

items.en: to promise; to undertake to do something

ex.zh: 我需要你承诺你会照我说的话去做。
ex.p: wǒ xū yào nǐ chéng nuò nǐ huì zhào wǒ shuō de huà qù zuò
ex.en: I need you to promise you'll do what I ask you to do.

ex.zh: 我们什么都不能承诺。
ex.p: wǒ men shén me dōu bù néng chéng nuò
ex.en: We can't promise anything.

ex.zh: 我被他的故事感染了。
ex.p: wǒ bèi tā de gù shì gǎn rǎn le
ex.en: I was very impressed by his story.

items.en: to start (a machine); (fig.) to set in motion

ex.zh: 重新启动你的电脑。
ex.p: chóng xīn qǐ dòng nǐ de diàn nǎo
ex.en: Restart your computer.

items.en: one by one; one after another

ex.zh: 你是唯一一个能帮助我们的人。
ex.p: nǐ shì wéi yī yī gè néng bāng zhù wǒ men de rén
ex.en: You're the only one who can help us.

ex.zh: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。
ex.p: wéi yī néng tīng dào de shēng yīn shì zhōng de dī dá shēng
ex.en: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.

ex.zh: 我感觉有滴雨落在头上。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn jué yǒu dī yù là zài tóu shàng
ex.en: I felt a drop of rain on my head.

ex.zh: 你知道为什么他今天逃课了吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào wèi shén me tā jīn tiān táo kè le ma
ex.en: Do you know why he skipped class today?

ex.zh: 他辞职后逃离了这个国家。
ex.p: tā cí zhí hòu táo lí le zhè gè guó jiā
ex.en: He resigned and fled the country.

ex.zh: 有些人害怕婚姻。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén hài pà hūn yīn
ex.en: Marriage frightens some people.

ex.zh: 这会打击我们的生意。
ex.p: zhè huì dǎ jī wǒ men de shēng yì
ex.en: This could hurt our business.

items.en: to shift; to relocate; to transfer

ex.zh: 这地方给我一个很差的印象。
ex.p: zhè dì fāng gěi wǒ yī gè hěn chà de yìn xiàng
ex.en: This place gives me a really bad vibe.

ex.zh: 请把每一页复印三份。
ex.p: qǐng bǎ měi yī yè fù yìn sān fèn
ex.en: Please make three copies of each page.

ex.zh: 你知道春卷为什么叫春卷吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào chūn juǎn wèi shén me jiào chūn juǎn ma
ex.en: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?

ex.zh: 他被卷进了是非中。
ex.p: tā bèi juǎn jìn le shì fēi zhōng
ex.en: He was involved in the trouble.

ex.zh: 我想尽快从这个不透气的屋子里出去。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng jǐn kuài cóng zhè gè bù tòu qì de wū zi lǐ chū qù
ex.en: I want to move out of this cramped room as soon as I can.

ex.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。
ex.p: wǒ bù tuī jiàn zài nà jiā cān guǎn chī fàn shí wù zāo gāo tòu le
ex.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.

ex.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请谨防食物中毒。
ex.p: yīn wèi kù shǔ yī zhí chí xù zhe qǐng jǐn fáng shí wù zhòng dú
ex.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.

ex.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请务必注意食物中毒。
ex.p: yīn wèi kù shǔ yī zhí chí xù zhe qǐng wù bì zhù yì shí wù zhòng dú
ex.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第104单元

Society and law

Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 耐心有时候是最有效的武器。
sents.p: nài xīn yǒu shí hou shì zuì yǒu xiào de wǔ qì
sents.en: Patience is sometimes the most effective weapon.

sents.zh: 把你的武器放下。
sents.p: bǎ nǐ de wǔ qì fàng xià
sents.en: Put your weapon down.

sents.zh: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。
sents.p: tā yòng qiān bǐ zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī gè juān
sents.en: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.

sents.zh: 我每个星期日礼拜完都买甜甜圈。
sents.p: wǒ měi gè xīng qī rì lǐ bài wán dōu mǎi tián tián juān
sents.en: I buy donuts every Sunday after church.

sents.zh: 她上飞机前，给我招了招手。
sents.p: tā shàng fēi jī qián gěi wǒ zhāo le zhāo shǒu
sents.en: She waved at me before she got on board the plane.

sents.zh: 失物招领处在哪儿？
sents.p: shī wù zhāo lǐng chǔ zài nǎr
sents.en: Where is the lost and found?

sents.zh: 一个正确的科学家不会那样想。
sents.p: yī gè zhèng què de kē xué jiā bù huì nà yàng xiǎng
sents.en: A true scientist wouldn't think like that.

sents.zh: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。
sents.p: zhè jǐ nián kē xué qǔ dé le xiǎn zhù de jìn bù
sents.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.

sents.zh: 中国的版图大概是日本的二十五倍。
sents.p: zhōng guó de bǎn tú dà gài shì rì běn de èr shí wǔ bèi
sents.en: China has about 25 times the area of Japan.

sents.zh: 我听过这首歌的法语版。
sents.p: wǒ tīng guò zhè shǒu gē de fǎ yǔ bǎn
sents.en: I heard the song sung in French.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢没有英雄的小说。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan méi yǒu yīng xióng de xiǎo shuō
sents.en: I don't like novels without heroes.

sents.zh: 他梦想着成为一名英雄。
sents.p: tā mèng xiǎng zhe chéng wéi yī míng yīng xióng
sents.en: He dreamed of being a hero.

sents.zh: 发言人的评论极有攻击性。
sents.p: fā yán rén de píng lùn jí yǒu gōng jī xìng
sents.en: The speaker's comments were highly offensive.

sents.zh: 敌人对我们发起了攻击。
sents.p: dí rén duì wǒ men fā qǐ le gōng jī
sents.en: The enemy launched an attack on us.

sents.zh: 我不想在城镇的那个地方买房
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài chéng zhèn de nà gè dì fāng mǎi fáng
sents.en: I wouldn't buy a house in that part of town.

sents.zh: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。
sents.p: qì chē wěi qì zài chéng zhèn lǐ zào chéng le yán zhòng de wū rǎn
sents.en: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.

sents.zh: 我注意到她当时戴了顶新帽子。
sents.p: wǒ zhù yì dào tā dāng shí dài le dǐng xīn mào zi
sents.en: I noticed she was wearing a new hat.

sents.zh: 我看见一架直升飞机在头顶飞。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī jià zhí shēng fēi jī zài tóu dǐng fēi
sents.en: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.

sents.zh: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi wǒ méi fàn rèn hé yán zhòng de cuò wù
sents.en: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.

sents.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。
sents.p: fàn zuì xiàn chǎng yǒu sān míng chuān zhì fú de jǐng chá
sents.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.

sents.zh: 她的衣服全部都是她自己做的。
sents.p: tā de yī fu quán bù dōu shì tā zì jǐ zuò de
sents.en: She makes all her own clothes.

sents.zh: 我把钱都花在衣服、食物和书籍上了。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ qián dōu huā zài yī fu shí wù hé shū jí shàng le
sents.en: I spent my money on clothes, food and books.

sents.zh: 布什继里根之后当上了总统。
sents.p: bù shén jì lǐ gēn zhī hòu dāng shàng le zǒng tǒng
sents.en: Bush followed Reagan as president.

sents.zh: 老师给我们布置了家庭作业。
sents.p: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men bù zhì le jiā tíng zuò yè
sents.en: The teacher gave us homework.

sents.zh: 不要再假装一切都好了，不是这样的！
sents.p: bù yào zài jiǎ zhuāng yī qiè dōu hǎo le bù shì zhè yàng de
sents.en: Stop pretending that everything's okay. It's not.

sents.zh: 听到这样的消息我真的很难过。
sents.p: tīng dào zhè yàng de xiāo xi wǒ zhēn de hěn nán guò
sents.en: I'm really sorry to hear that.

sents.zh: 我理所当然地觉得，他会通过考试。
sents.p: wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán de jué de tā huì tōng guò kǎo shì
sents.en: I took it for granted that he would pass the exam.

sents.zh: 你很快就会习惯吃日本料理了。
sents.p: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn chī rì běn liào lǐ le
sents.en: You'll soon get used to Japanese food.

sents.zh: 他们一定很恨我。
sents.p: tā men yī dìng hěn hèn wǒ
sents.en: They must really hate me.

sents.zh: 你为什么恨我？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me hèn wǒ
sents.en: Why do you hate me?

sents.zh: 虽然有阳光照射，但还是很冷。
sents.p: suī rán yǒu yáng guāng zhào shè dàn hái shi hěn lěng
sents.en: The sun was shining, yet it was cold.

sents.zh: 今年的时尚潮流完全不同于去年。
sents.p: jīn nián de shí shàng cháo liú wán quán bù tóng yú qù nián
sents.en: This year's fashions are completely different from last year's.

sents.zh: 跟上最近潮流时尚是件非常花钱的事儿。
sents.p: gēn shàng zuì jìn cháo liú shí shàng shì jiàn fēi cháng huā qián de shì ér
sents.en: It is very expensive to keep up with the latest fashions.

sents.zh: 他以优异的成绩毕业于剑桥大学。
sents.p: tā yǐ yōu yì de chéng jì bì yè yú jiàn qiáo dà xué
sents.en: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.

sents.zh: 没有什么和和平一样重要。
sents.p: méi yǒu shén me hé hé píng yī yàng zhòng yào
sents.en: Nothing's as important as peace.

sents.zh: 整个世界都需要和平。
sents.p: zhěng gè shì jiè dōu xū yào hé píng
sents.en: The entire world desires peace.

sents.zh: 当汽车爆炸时，车上只有三名乘客。
sents.p: dāng qì chē bào zhà shí chē shàng zhǐ yǒu sān míng chéng kè
sents.en: There were only three passengers on the bus when it exploded.

sents.zh: 很多人在随后的爆炸中死去。
sents.p: hěn duō rén zài suí hòu de bào zhà zhōng sǐ qù
sents.en: The explosion that followed killed many people.

sents.zh: 那个时候，没有人在这个岛上生活。
sents.p: nà gè shí hou méi yǒu rén zài zhè gè dǎo shàng shēng huó
sents.en: No one lived on the island at that time.

sents.zh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。
sents.p: zhè gè dǎo shì hái zi men de tiān táng
sents.en: The island is a paradise for children.

sents.zh: 这是战斗发生的地方。
sents.p: zhè shì zhàn dòu fā shēng de dì fāng
sents.en: This is the place where the battle took place.

sents.zh: 像男人一样战斗！
sents.p: xiàng nán rén yī yàng zhàn dòu
sents.en: Fight like a man!

sents.zh: 我不喜欢把生意和快乐混在一起。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan bǎ shēng yì hé kuài lè hún zài yī qǐ
sents.en: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.

sents.zh: 众所周知，空气是多种气体的混合体。
sents.p: zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī kōng qì shì duō zhǒng qì tǐ de hùn hé tǐ
sents.en: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.

sents.zh: 别把人家当傻瓜。
sents.p: bié bǎ rén jiā dāng shǎ guā
sents.en: Don't make a fool of me.

sents.zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。
sents.p: fǎng kè tōng cháng zài jìn rù yī hù rì běn rén jiā zhī qián huì bèi yāo qiú tuō xié
sents.en: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.

sents.zh: 我已经头疼三天了，还没摆脱它。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ jīng tóu téng sān tiān le hái méi bǎi tuō tā
sents.en: I've had a headache for three days and I can't get rid of it.

sents.zh: 大好的前途摆在他面前。
sents.p: dà hǎo de qián tú bǎi zài tā miàn qián
sents.en: A brilliant future lay before him.

sents.zh: 猴子跳到他身上的时候，他受到了惊吓。
sents.p: hóu zi tiào dào tā shēn shang de shí hou tā shòu dào le jīng hè
sents.en: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.

sents.zh: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。
sents.p: wǒ zǒng jué de mù ǒu xì yǒu diǎn xià rén
sents.en: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.

sents.zh: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
sents.p: rì běn jūn duì kàn lai qiáng dà de bù kě zǔ dǎng
sents.en: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.

sents.zh: 军队占领了整片领土。
sents.p: jūn duì zhàn lǐng le zhěng piàn lǐng tǔ
sents.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

sents.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi duì rén shǐ yòng jī yīn biān jí ma
sents.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

sents.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。
sents.p: wǒ biān yì zhè gè chéng xù yǒu xiē kùn nan
sents.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.

sents.zh: 她照顾可怜的小鸟。
sents.p: tā zhào gu kě lián de xiǎo niǎo
sents.en: She took care of the poor little bird.

sents.zh: 这个可怜的年轻人最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。
sents.p: zhè gè kě lián de nián qīng rén zuì hòu chéng wéi le yī gè liǎo bù qǐ de yì shù jiā
sents.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.

sents.zh: 你为何想当一个老师？
sents.p: nǐ wèi hé xiǎng dāng yī gè lǎo shī
sents.en: Why did you want to become a teacher?

sents.zh: 不知道第三次世界大战会不会爆发。
sents.p: bù zhī dào dì sān cì shì jiè dà zhàn huì bù huì bào fā
sents.en: I wonder if a third world war will break out.

sents.zh: 在全体职员回家后，火事爆发了。
sents.p: zài quán tǐ zhí yuán huí jiā hòu huǒ shì bào fā le
sents.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.

sents.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请谨防食物中毒。
sents.p: yīn wèi kù shǔ yī zhí chí xù zhe qǐng jǐn fáng shí wù zhòng dú
sents.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.

sents.zh: 因为酷暑一直持续着，请务必注意食物中毒。
sents.p: yīn wèi kù shǔ yī zhí chí xù zhe qǐng wù bì zhù yì shí wù zhòng dú
sents.en: Hot weather will continue, so please watch out for food poisoning.

sents.zh: 你知道中央情报局的什么？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de shén me
sents.en: What do you know about the CIA?

sents.zh: 图书馆位于市中央。
sents.p: tú shū guǎn wèi yú shì zhōng yāng
sents.en: The library is in the middle of the city.

sents.zh: 您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？
sents.p: nín néng wèi wǒ jiě shì zhè jù jù zi de yì si ma
sents.en: Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?

sents.zh: 我认为我们刚开始了解这个问题。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi wǒ men gāng kāi shǐ liǎo jiě zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: I think we're just beginning to understand the problem.

sents.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。
sents.p: liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu xiǎn zhù de chā bié
sents.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.

sents.zh: 我需要你承诺你会照我说的话去做。
sents.p: wǒ xū yào nǐ chéng nuò nǐ huì zhào wǒ shuō de huà qù zuò
sents.en: I need you to promise you'll do what I ask you to do.

sents.zh: 我们什么都不能承诺。
sents.p: wǒ men shén me dōu bù néng chéng nuò
sents.en: We can't promise anything.

sents.zh: 我被他的故事感染了。
sents.p: wǒ bèi tā de gù shì gǎn rǎn le
sents.en: I was very impressed by his story.

sents.zh: 重新启动你的电脑。
sents.p: chóng xīn qǐ dòng nǐ de diàn nǎo
sents.en: Restart your computer.

sents.zh: 你是唯一一个能帮助我们的人。
sents.p: nǐ shì wéi yī yī gè néng bāng zhù wǒ men de rén
sents.en: You're the only one who can help us.

sents.zh: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。
sents.p: wéi yī néng tīng dào de shēng yīn shì zhōng de dī dá shēng
sents.en: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.

sents.zh: 我感觉有滴雨落在头上。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn jué yǒu dī yù là zài tóu shàng
sents.en: I felt a drop of rain on my head.

sents.zh: 你知道为什么他今天逃课了吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào wèi shén me tā jīn tiān táo kè le ma
sents.en: Do you know why he skipped class today?

sents.zh: 他辞职后逃离了这个国家。
sents.p: tā cí zhí hòu táo lí le zhè gè guó jiā
sents.en: He resigned and fled the country.

sents.zh: 有些人害怕婚姻。
sents.p: yǒu xiē rén hài pà hūn yīn
sents.en: Marriage frightens some people.

sents.zh: 这会打击我们的生意。
sents.p: zhè huì dǎ jī wǒ men de shēng yì
sents.en: This could hurt our business.

sents.zh: 这地方给我一个很差的印象。
sents.p: zhè dì fāng gěi wǒ yī gè hěn chà de yìn xiàng
sents.en: This place gives me a really bad vibe.

sents.zh: 请把每一页复印三份。
sents.p: qǐng bǎ měi yī yè fù yìn sān fèn
sents.en: Please make three copies of each page.

sents.zh: 你知道春卷为什么叫春卷吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào chūn juǎn wèi shén me jiào chūn juǎn ma
sents.en: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?

sents.zh: 他被卷进了是非中。
sents.p: tā bèi juǎn jìn le shì fēi zhōng
sents.en: He was involved in the trouble.

sents.zh: 我想尽快从这个不透气的屋子里出去。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng jǐn kuài cóng zhè gè bù tòu qì de wū zi lǐ chū qù
sents.en: I want to move out of this cramped room as soon as I can.

sents.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。
sents.p: wǒ bù tuī jiàn zài nà jiā cān guǎn chī fàn shí wù zāo gāo tòu le
sents.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.

units.title: Society and law
units.intro: Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

ex.zh: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiàng wǒ yǐ qián nà me tuō yán le
ex.en: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.

ex.zh: 不要拖延去找工作的事。
ex.p: bù yào tuō yán qù zhǎo gōng zuò de shì
ex.en: Stop putting off finding a job.

ex.zh: 在这儿等到他回来为止。
ex.p: zài zhèr děng dào tā huí lai wéi zhǐ
ex.en: Wait here till he comes back.

ex.zh: 今天就到此为止吧。
ex.p: jīn tiān jiù dào cǐ wéi zhǐ ba
ex.en: Let's call it a day.

items.en: to make headway; to make progress

ex.zh: 已经取得巨大进展。
ex.p: yǐ jīng qǔ dé jù dà jìn zhǎn
ex.en: Great progress has been made.

ex.zh: 你的项目进展得怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ de xiàng mù jìn zhǎn de zěn me yàng
ex.en: How's your project going?

items.en: to stop up; to squeeze in

ex.zh: 市中心的交通都堵塞了。
ex.p: shì zhōng xīn de jiāo tōng dōu dǔ sè le
ex.en: Traffic downtown is all backed up.

ex.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。
ex.p: tā gāng fā biǎo yī xì liè yǒu qù de wén zhāng
ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.

ex.zh: 什么是格式塔疗法？
ex.p: shén me shì gé shì tǎ liáo fǎ
ex.en: What is Gestalt Therapy?

ex.zh: 您参观过东京塔吗？
ex.p: nín cān guān guò dōng jīng tǎ ma
ex.en: Did you visit the Tokyo Tower?

items.en: the truth about sth; the actual facts

ex.zh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。
ex.p: tā chéng gōng de cóng tā kǒu zhōng dé zhī le zhēn xiàng
ex.en: She successfully got him to tell the truth.

ex.zh: 如果我知道真相，我就告诉你了。
ex.p: rú guǒ wǒ zhī dào zhēn xiàng wǒ jiù gào sù nǐ le
ex.en: If I'd known the truth, I'd have told you.

ex.zh: 快点，你就能准时搭上公交车了。
ex.p: kuài diǎn nǐ jiù néng zhǔn shí dā shàng gōng jiāo chē le
ex.en: Hurry up, and you will be in time for the bus.

ex.zh: 她搭上了去原宿的巴士。
ex.p: tā dā shàng le qù yuán sù de bā shì
ex.en: She got on a bus for Harajuku.

items.en: not in the least; to completely lack

ex.zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。
ex.p: méi yǒu ài qíng de shēng huó háo wú yì yì
ex.en: Life without love has no meaning at all.

ex.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。
ex.p: tā shuō de huà gēn běn háo wú yì yì
ex.en: What he says is total nonsense.

ex.zh: 你一直在制造麻烦。
ex.p: nǐ yī zhí zài zhì zào má fan
ex.en: You've been causing problems.

ex.zh: 我的钱包是皮制的。
ex.p: wǒ de qián bāo shì pí zhì de
ex.en: My wallet is made of leather.

ex.zh: 我泡了个澡身体暖和起来了。
ex.p: wǒ pāo le gè zǎo shēn tǐ nuǎn huo qǐ lai le
ex.en: I warmed myself in the bath.

ex.zh: 三个灯泡烧坏了。
ex.p: sān gè dēng pào shāo huài le
ex.en: Three bulbs have burned out.

ex.zh: 我们能从窗户看到日落。
ex.p: wǒ men néng cóng chuāng hu kàn dào rì là
ex.en: We could see the sunset from the window.

ex.zh: 我不想打开窗户。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng dǎ kāi chuāng hu
ex.en: I don't want to open the window.

items.en: to return; to go back to

ex.zh: 他将他的成功归功于好运。
ex.p: tā jiāng tā de chéng gōng guī gōng yú hǎo yùn
ex.en: He attributes his success to good luck.

ex.zh: 他把他的成功归功于好运。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de chéng gōng guī gōng yú hǎo yùn
ex.en: He attributed his success to good luck.

ex.zh: 他的胸中还有足够的斗志。
ex.p: tā de xiōng zhōng hái yǒu zú gòu de dòu zhì
ex.en: He had plenty of fight left in him.

items.en: (of a woman) to marry; to marry off a daughter

ex.zh: 她为了他的钱嫁给了他。
ex.p: tā wèi le tā de qián jià gěi le tā
ex.en: She married him for his money.

ex.zh: 我妹妹嫁给了一个医生。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei jià gěi le yī gè yī shēng
ex.en: My sister married a doctor.

ex.zh: 他命令我立刻离开这个房间。
ex.p: tā mìng lìng wǒ lì kè lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān
ex.en: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.

ex.zh: 他的医生命令他休息。
ex.p: tā de yī shēng mìng lìng tā xiū xi
ex.en: His doctor ordered him to rest.

ex.zh: 要都解释的话，需要一辈子的时间。
ex.p: yào dōu jiě shì de huà xū yào yī bèi zi de shí jiān
ex.en: It would take forever for me to explain everything.

ex.zh: 我想我会一辈子单身。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng wǒ huì yī bèi zi dān shēn
ex.en: I guess I'm never going to get married.

ex.zh: 他们给士兵提供了充足的食物和水。
ex.p: tā men gěi shì bīng tí gōng le chōng zú de shí wù hé shuǐ
ex.en: They supplied the soldiers with enough food and water.

ex.zh: 士兵们失去了战斗的勇气。
ex.p: shì bīng men shī qù le zhàn dòu de yǒng qì
ex.en: The soldiers lost the courage to fight.

ex.zh: 我不敢相信你父母让你自己过来。
ex.p: wǒ bù gǎn xiāng xìn nǐ fù mǔ ràng nǐ zì jǐ guò lái
ex.en: I can't believe your parents let you come here by yourself.

ex.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
ex.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.

ex.zh: 他们的评论很有启发性。
ex.p: tā men de píng lùn hěn yǒu qǐ fā xìng
ex.en: Their comments were illuminating.

ex.zh: 欢迎作任何评论。
ex.p: huān yíng zuō rèn hé píng lùn
ex.en: Any comments are welcome.

ex.zh: 仪式以他的讲话开始。
ex.p: yí shì yǐ tā de jiǎng huà kāi shǐ
ex.en: The ceremony began with his speech.

ex.zh: 为了不感冒，请带上这件毛衣。
ex.p: wèi le bù gǎn mào qǐng dài shàng zhè jiàn máo yī
ex.en: Take a sweater with you so you don't catch a cold.

ex.zh: 我们别无选择只能冒着危险。
ex.p: wǒ men bié wú xuǎn zé zhǐ néng mào zhe wēi xiǎn
ex.en: We have no choice but to risk it.

ex.zh: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。
ex.p: jié guǒ wǒ men zài nà pò pò làn làn de cān guǎn lǐ chī le fàn
ex.en: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.

items.en: to get rid of; to remove

ex.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
ex.p: chú le gāng qín yǐ wài hái huì wán shén me yuè qì ma
ex.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?

ex.zh: 我除了星期天外每天都上班。
ex.p: wǒ chú le xīng qī tiān wài měi tiān dōu shàng bān
ex.en: I work every day but Sunday.

ex.zh: 能不能请你拿着这端？
ex.p: néng bù néng qǐng nǐ ná zhe zhè duān
ex.en: Will you please hold this edge?

ex.zh: 这是一个好的开端。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè hǎo de kāi duān
ex.en: It's a good start.

ex.zh: 今晚我度过了一段非常美好的时光。
ex.p: jīn wǎn wǒ dù guò le yī duàn fēi cháng měi hǎo de shí guāng
ex.en: I had a really nice time tonight.

ex.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。
ex.p: nà shì wǒ yī shēng zhōng zuì měi hǎo de shí guāng zhī yī
ex.en: That was one of the best times of my life.

ex.zh: 你不想做编辑？
ex.p: nǐ bù xiǎng zuò biān jí
ex.en: You don't want to be an editor?

ex.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi duì rén shǐ yòng jī yīn biān jí ma
ex.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

ex.zh: 你可以在地上挖土。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ zài dì shang wā tǔ
ex.en: You can dig dirt from the ground.

ex.zh: 他挖了一个洞。
ex.p: tā wā le yī gè dòng
ex.en: He dug a hole.

items.en: to confirm (sth to be true); to verify

ex.zh: 这一结果证实了我的猜想。
ex.p: zhè yī jié guǒ zhèng shí le wǒ de cāi xiǎng
ex.en: The result confirmed my hypothesis.

ex.zh: 我自己能够证实那是真的。
ex.p: wǒ zì jǐ néng gòu zhèng shí nà shì zhēn de
ex.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.

items.en: or; either one or the other

ex.zh: 不好意思，但我有点恶心。
ex.p: bù hǎo yì si dàn wǒ yǒu diǎn ě xīn
ex.en: Excuse me, but I feel sick.

ex.zh: 你本不该透露秘密的。
ex.p: nǐ běn bù gāi tòu lù mì mì de
ex.en: You ought not to have disclosed the secret.

ex.zh: 在回家的路上，我看到一场阅兵式。
ex.p: zài huí jiā de lù shang wǒ kàn dào yī chǎng yuè bīng shì
ex.en: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.

ex.zh: 很快，城市就被士兵占领了。
ex.p: hěn kuài chéng shì jiù bèi shì bīng zhàn lǐng le
ex.en: The city was soon occupied by the soldiers.

ex.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。
ex.p: gōng sī yóu yú quē fá zī běn dǎo bì le
ex.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.

ex.zh: 公司很快就要倒闭了。
ex.p: gōng sī hěn kuài jiù yào dǎo bì le
ex.en: The company will soon go bankrupt.

ex.zh: 天气异常寒冷。
ex.p: tiān qì yì cháng hán lěng
ex.en: The weather is unusually cold.

ex.zh: 我的笔记本是粉色的。
ex.p: wǒ de bǐ jì běn shì fěn sè de
ex.en: My notebook is pink.

ex.zh: 桌上布满了粉末。
ex.p: zhuō shàng bù mǎn le fěn mò
ex.en: The table is covered with powder.

ex.zh: 他既不喜欢棒球，又不喜欢足球。
ex.p: tā jì bù xǐ huan bàng qiú yòu bù xǐ huan zú qiú
ex.en: He likes neither baseball nor football.

ex.zh: 你在电视上看足球赛了吗？
ex.p: nǐ zài diàn shì shàng kàn zú qiú sài le ma
ex.en: Did you watch the soccer game on television?

ex.zh: 他是一位著名的作曲家。
ex.p: tā shì yī wèi zhù míng de zuō qū jiā
ex.en: He is a famous composer.

ex.zh: 你为什么买这么多曲奇？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me mǎi zhè me duō qū qí
ex.en: Why did you buy so many cookies?

ex.zh: 我给自己的邮件做了一份档案。
ex.p: wǒ gěi zì jǐ de yóu jiàn zuò le yī fèn dàng àn
ex.en: I created an archive of my emails.

ex.zh: 他试图把注意力集中在信上。
ex.p: tā shì tú bǎ zhù yì lì jí zhōng zài xìn shàng
ex.en: He tried to concentrate on the letter.

ex.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
ex.p: tā shì tú yóu guò hé dàn shì shī bài le
ex.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.

ex.zh: 等候室里有五位患者。
ex.p: děng hòu shì lǐ yǒu wǔ wèi huàn zhě
ex.en: There are five patients in the waiting room.

ex.zh: 这些患者走路有困难。
ex.p: zhè xiē huàn zhě zǒu lù yǒu kùn nan
ex.en: These patients have trouble walking.

ex.zh: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī sōu chuán dài wǒ yuǎn lí zhè lǐ
ex.en: I want a boat that'll take me far away from here.

ex.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。
ex.p: zhè sōu chuán tài dà méi fǎ tōng guò yùn hé
ex.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第105单元

Society and law

Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiàng wǒ yǐ qián nà me tuō yán le
sents.en: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.

sents.zh: 不要拖延去找工作的事。
sents.p: bù yào tuō yán qù zhǎo gōng zuò de shì
sents.en: Stop putting off finding a job.

sents.zh: 在这儿等到他回来为止。
sents.p: zài zhèr děng dào tā huí lai wéi zhǐ
sents.en: Wait here till he comes back.

sents.zh: 今天就到此为止吧。
sents.p: jīn tiān jiù dào cǐ wéi zhǐ ba
sents.en: Let's call it a day.

sents.zh: 已经取得巨大进展。
sents.p: yǐ jīng qǔ dé jù dà jìn zhǎn
sents.en: Great progress has been made.

sents.zh: 你的项目进展得怎么样？
sents.p: nǐ de xiàng mù jìn zhǎn de zěn me yàng
sents.en: How's your project going?

sents.zh: 市中心的交通都堵塞了。
sents.p: shì zhōng xīn de jiāo tōng dōu dǔ sè le
sents.en: Traffic downtown is all backed up.

sents.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。
sents.p: tā gāng fā biǎo yī xì liè yǒu qù de wén zhāng
sents.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.

sents.zh: 什么是格式塔疗法？
sents.p: shén me shì gé shì tǎ liáo fǎ
sents.en: What is Gestalt Therapy?

sents.zh: 您参观过东京塔吗？
sents.p: nín cān guān guò dōng jīng tǎ ma
sents.en: Did you visit the Tokyo Tower?

sents.zh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。
sents.p: tā chéng gōng de cóng tā kǒu zhōng dé zhī le zhēn xiàng
sents.en: She successfully got him to tell the truth.

sents.zh: 如果我知道真相，我就告诉你了。
sents.p: rú guǒ wǒ zhī dào zhēn xiàng wǒ jiù gào sù nǐ le
sents.en: If I'd known the truth, I'd have told you.

sents.zh: 快点，你就能准时搭上公交车了。
sents.p: kuài diǎn nǐ jiù néng zhǔn shí dā shàng gōng jiāo chē le
sents.en: Hurry up, and you will be in time for the bus.

sents.zh: 她搭上了去原宿的巴士。
sents.p: tā dā shàng le qù yuán sù de bā shì
sents.en: She got on a bus for Harajuku.

sents.zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。
sents.p: méi yǒu ài qíng de shēng huó háo wú yì yì
sents.en: Life without love has no meaning at all.

sents.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。
sents.p: tā shuō de huà gēn běn háo wú yì yì
sents.en: What he says is total nonsense.

sents.zh: 你一直在制造麻烦。
sents.p: nǐ yī zhí zài zhì zào má fan
sents.en: You've been causing problems.

sents.zh: 我的钱包是皮制的。
sents.p: wǒ de qián bāo shì pí zhì de
sents.en: My wallet is made of leather.

sents.zh: 我泡了个澡身体暖和起来了。
sents.p: wǒ pāo le gè zǎo shēn tǐ nuǎn huo qǐ lai le
sents.en: I warmed myself in the bath.

sents.zh: 三个灯泡烧坏了。
sents.p: sān gè dēng pào shāo huài le
sents.en: Three bulbs have burned out.

sents.zh: 我们能从窗户看到日落。
sents.p: wǒ men néng cóng chuāng hu kàn dào rì là
sents.en: We could see the sunset from the window.

sents.zh: 我不想打开窗户。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng dǎ kāi chuāng hu
sents.en: I don't want to open the window.

sents.zh: 他将他的成功归功于好运。
sents.p: tā jiāng tā de chéng gōng guī gōng yú hǎo yùn
sents.en: He attributes his success to good luck.

sents.zh: 他把他的成功归功于好运。
sents.p: tā bǎ tā de chéng gōng guī gōng yú hǎo yùn
sents.en: He attributed his success to good luck.

sents.zh: 他的胸中还有足够的斗志。
sents.p: tā de xiōng zhōng hái yǒu zú gòu de dòu zhì
sents.en: He had plenty of fight left in him.

sents.zh: 她为了他的钱嫁给了他。
sents.p: tā wèi le tā de qián jià gěi le tā
sents.en: She married him for his money.

sents.zh: 我妹妹嫁给了一个医生。
sents.p: wǒ mèi mei jià gěi le yī gè yī shēng
sents.en: My sister married a doctor.

sents.zh: 他命令我立刻离开这个房间。
sents.p: tā mìng lìng wǒ lì kè lí kāi zhè gè fáng jiān
sents.en: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.

sents.zh: 他的医生命令他休息。
sents.p: tā de yī shēng mìng lìng tā xiū xi
sents.en: His doctor ordered him to rest.

sents.zh: 要都解释的话，需要一辈子的时间。
sents.p: yào dōu jiě shì de huà xū yào yī bèi zi de shí jiān
sents.en: It would take forever for me to explain everything.

sents.zh: 我想我会一辈子单身。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng wǒ huì yī bèi zi dān shēn
sents.en: I guess I'm never going to get married.

sents.zh: 他们给士兵提供了充足的食物和水。
sents.p: tā men gěi shì bīng tí gōng le chōng zú de shí wù hé shuǐ
sents.en: They supplied the soldiers with enough food and water.

sents.zh: 士兵们失去了战斗的勇气。
sents.p: shì bīng men shī qù le zhàn dòu de yǒng qì
sents.en: The soldiers lost the courage to fight.

sents.zh: 我不敢相信你父母让你自己过来。
sents.p: wǒ bù gǎn xiāng xìn nǐ fù mǔ ràng nǐ zì jǐ guò lái
sents.en: I can't believe your parents let you come here by yourself.

sents.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
sents.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.

sents.zh: 他们的评论很有启发性。
sents.p: tā men de píng lùn hěn yǒu qǐ fā xìng
sents.en: Their comments were illuminating.

sents.zh: 欢迎作任何评论。
sents.p: huān yíng zuō rèn hé píng lùn
sents.en: Any comments are welcome.

sents.zh: 仪式以他的讲话开始。
sents.p: yí shì yǐ tā de jiǎng huà kāi shǐ
sents.en: The ceremony began with his speech.

sents.zh: 为了不感冒，请带上这件毛衣。
sents.p: wèi le bù gǎn mào qǐng dài shàng zhè jiàn máo yī
sents.en: Take a sweater with you so you don't catch a cold.

sents.zh: 我们别无选择只能冒着危险。
sents.p: wǒ men bié wú xuǎn zé zhǐ néng mào zhe wēi xiǎn
sents.en: We have no choice but to risk it.

sents.zh: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。
sents.p: jié guǒ wǒ men zài nà pò pò làn làn de cān guǎn lǐ chī le fàn
sents.en: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.

sents.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
sents.p: chú le gāng qín yǐ wài hái huì wán shén me yuè qì ma
sents.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?

sents.zh: 我除了星期天外每天都上班。
sents.p: wǒ chú le xīng qī tiān wài měi tiān dōu shàng bān
sents.en: I work every day but Sunday.

sents.zh: 能不能请你拿着这端？
sents.p: néng bù néng qǐng nǐ ná zhe zhè duān
sents.en: Will you please hold this edge?

sents.zh: 这是一个好的开端。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè hǎo de kāi duān
sents.en: It's a good start.

sents.zh: 今晚我度过了一段非常美好的时光。
sents.p: jīn wǎn wǒ dù guò le yī duàn fēi cháng měi hǎo de shí guāng
sents.en: I had a really nice time tonight.

sents.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。
sents.p: nà shì wǒ yī shēng zhōng zuì měi hǎo de shí guāng zhī yī
sents.en: That was one of the best times of my life.

sents.zh: 你不想做编辑？
sents.p: nǐ bù xiǎng zuò biān jí
sents.en: You don't want to be an editor?

sents.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi duì rén shǐ yòng jī yīn biān jí ma
sents.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

sents.zh: 你可以在地上挖土。
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ zài dì shang wā tǔ
sents.en: You can dig dirt from the ground.

sents.zh: 他挖了一个洞。
sents.p: tā wā le yī gè dòng
sents.en: He dug a hole.

sents.zh: 这一结果证实了我的猜想。
sents.p: zhè yī jié guǒ zhèng shí le wǒ de cāi xiǎng
sents.en: The result confirmed my hypothesis.

sents.zh: 我自己能够证实那是真的。
sents.p: wǒ zì jǐ néng gòu zhèng shí nà shì zhēn de
sents.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.

sents.zh: 不好意思，但我有点恶心。
sents.p: bù hǎo yì si dàn wǒ yǒu diǎn ě xīn
sents.en: Excuse me, but I feel sick.

sents.zh: 你本不该透露秘密的。
sents.p: nǐ běn bù gāi tòu lù mì mì de
sents.en: You ought not to have disclosed the secret.

sents.zh: 在回家的路上，我看到一场阅兵式。
sents.p: zài huí jiā de lù shang wǒ kàn dào yī chǎng yuè bīng shì
sents.en: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.

sents.zh: 很快，城市就被士兵占领了。
sents.p: hěn kuài chéng shì jiù bèi shì bīng zhàn lǐng le
sents.en: The city was soon occupied by the soldiers.

sents.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。
sents.p: gōng sī yóu yú quē fá zī běn dǎo bì le
sents.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.

sents.zh: 公司很快就要倒闭了。
sents.p: gōng sī hěn kuài jiù yào dǎo bì le
sents.en: The company will soon go bankrupt.

sents.zh: 天气异常寒冷。
sents.p: tiān qì yì cháng hán lěng
sents.en: The weather is unusually cold.

sents.zh: 我的笔记本是粉色的。
sents.p: wǒ de bǐ jì běn shì fěn sè de
sents.en: My notebook is pink.

sents.zh: 桌上布满了粉末。
sents.p: zhuō shàng bù mǎn le fěn mò
sents.en: The table is covered with powder.

sents.zh: 他既不喜欢棒球，又不喜欢足球。
sents.p: tā jì bù xǐ huan bàng qiú yòu bù xǐ huan zú qiú
sents.en: He likes neither baseball nor football.

sents.zh: 你在电视上看足球赛了吗？
sents.p: nǐ zài diàn shì shàng kàn zú qiú sài le ma
sents.en: Did you watch the soccer game on television?

sents.zh: 他是一位著名的作曲家。
sents.p: tā shì yī wèi zhù míng de zuō qū jiā
sents.en: He is a famous composer.

sents.zh: 你为什么买这么多曲奇？
sents.p: nǐ wèi shén me mǎi zhè me duō qū qí
sents.en: Why did you buy so many cookies?

sents.zh: 我给自己的邮件做了一份档案。
sents.p: wǒ gěi zì jǐ de yóu jiàn zuò le yī fèn dàng àn
sents.en: I created an archive of my emails.

sents.zh: 他试图把注意力集中在信上。
sents.p: tā shì tú bǎ zhù yì lì jí zhōng zài xìn shàng
sents.en: He tried to concentrate on the letter.

sents.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
sents.p: tā shì tú yóu guò hé dàn shì shī bài le
sents.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.

sents.zh: 等候室里有五位患者。
sents.p: děng hòu shì lǐ yǒu wǔ wèi huàn zhě
sents.en: There are five patients in the waiting room.

sents.zh: 这些患者走路有困难。
sents.p: zhè xiē huàn zhě zǒu lù yǒu kùn nan
sents.en: These patients have trouble walking.

sents.zh: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī sōu chuán dài wǒ yuǎn lí zhè lǐ
sents.en: I want a boat that'll take me far away from here.

sents.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。
sents.p: zhè sōu chuán tài dà méi fǎ tōng guò yùn hé
sents.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.

units.title: Society and law
units.intro: Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

ex.zh: 他冒着失去所有财产的危险。
ex.p: tā mào zhe shī qù suǒ yǒu cái chǎn de wēi xiǎn
ex.en: He risked losing all his fortune.

ex.zh: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de cái chǎn chuán gěi le tā ér zi
ex.en: He passed his property on to his son.

ex.zh: 你知道银行什么时候关门吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào yín háng shén me shí hou guān mén ma
ex.en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?

ex.zh: 这辆车在银行前面停下来了。
ex.p: zhè liàng chē zài yín háng qián miàn tíng xià lái le
ex.en: The car pulled up in front of the bank.

ex.zh: 你变了那么多，以至于我几乎认不出你了。
ex.p: nǐ biàn le nà me duō yǐ zhì yú wǒ jī hū rèn bù chū nǐ le
ex.en: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.

ex.zh: 我有那么多衣服，以至于我不知道明天穿什么了。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu nà me duō yī fu yǐ zhì yú wǒ bù zhī dào míng tiān chuān shén me le
ex.en: I have so many clothes I don't know what to wear tomorrow.

ex.zh: 我必须要减肥了。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū yào jiǎn féi le
ex.en: I have to lose weight.

ex.zh: 这个产品称它能帮助你减肥。
ex.p: zhè gè chǎn pǐn chèn tā néng bāng zhù nǐ jiǎn féi
ex.en: This product claims to help you lose weight.

ex.zh: 昨天这家商店正好人满为患。
ex.p: zuó tiān zhè jiā shāng diàn zhèng hǎo rén mǎn wèi huàn
ex.en: The store happened to be crowded yesterday.

ex.zh: 我患上了重感冒。
ex.p: wǒ huàn shàng le zhòng gǎn mào
ex.en: I'm suffering from a bad cold.

items.en: camera lens; camera shot (in a movie etc)
a loan; to provide a loan (e.g. bank)

ex.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。
ex.p: yín háng duì fēng xiǎn kè hù shōu qǔ jiào gāo de dài kuǎn lì xī
ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.

ex.zh: 你可以从银行贷款。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ cóng yín háng dài kuǎn
ex.en: You can get a loan from a bank.

items.en: very early in the morning; in the wee hours
to do harm to; to cause trouble to

ex.zh: 小女孩害怕从屋顶上跳下来。
ex.p: xiǎo nǚ hái hài pà cóng wū dǐng shàng tiào xià lai
ex.en: The girl was afraid to jump down from the roof.

ex.zh: 我的妻子害怕开我的新车。
ex.p: wǒ de qī zǐ hài pà kāi wǒ de xīn chē
ex.en: My wife is afraid to drive my new car.

ex.zh: 他是国立大学的一名教授。
ex.p: tā shì guó lì dà xué de yī míng jiào shòu
ex.en: He's a professor at the National University.

ex.zh: 你在私立学校读书吗？
ex.p: nǐ zài sī lì xué xiào dú shū ma
ex.en: Do you go to a private school?

ex.zh: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba cān jiā le liào lǐ jìng sài bìng dé le dì yī míng
ex.en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.

ex.zh: 你最喜欢的饮料是什么？
ex.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de yǐn liào shì shén me
ex.en: What's your favorite drink?

ex.zh: 我认为这可以撒些盐。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi zhè kě yǐ sā xiē yán
ex.en: I think that it could use some salt.

ex.zh: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。
ex.p: zāo shòu xīn zàng bìng kùn rǎo de rén shù zēng jiā le
ex.en: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.

ex.zh: 这是个很艰难的斗争。
ex.p: zhè shì gè hěn jiān nán de dòu zhēng
ex.en: It was an uphill struggle.

ex.zh: 难民与饥饿作斗争。
ex.p: nán mín yǔ jī è zuō dòu zhēng
ex.en: The refugees struggled against hunger.

items.en: (literary) to give; to accord; to render
to break through; to make a breakthrough

ex.zh: 著名的钢琴家露出了微笑。
ex.p: zhù míng de gāng qín jiā lòu chū le wēi xiào
ex.en: The famous pianist smiled.

ex.zh: 好运向他露出了笑容。
ex.p: hǎo yùn xiàng tā lòu chū le xiào róng
ex.en: Fortune smiled on him.

items.en: for this reason; with regards to this

ex.zh: 如果可能的话，我想环游世界。
ex.p: rú guǒ kě néng de huà wǒ xiǎng huán yóu shì jiè
ex.en: If possible, I'd like to travel around the world.

ex.zh: 她去年环球旅行。
ex.p: tā qù nián huán qiú lǚ xíng

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第106单元

Society and law

Grammar focus: Formal written words: 予以, 加以, 将, 于

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.en: I'll give you a little tip.

sents.zh: 他们是典型的年轻人。
sents.p: tā men shì diǎn xíng de nián qīng rén
sents.en: They're typical youngsters.

sents.zh: 记好了这教训。
sents.p: jì hǎo le zhè jiào xun
sents.en: Keep this lesson in mind.

sents.zh: 除非雨停了，我们才会出去。
sents.p: chú fēi yù tíng le wǒ men cái huì chū qù
sents.en: We won't go out unless it stops raining.

sents.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。
sents.p: chú fēi tā men shì xiān xiū hǎo shā chē wǒ cái huì mǎi chē zǐ
sents.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.

sents.zh: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。
sents.p: wǒ men zài dì sān zhāng tǎo lùn zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.

sents.zh: 这篇文章没有价值。
sents.p: zhè piān wén zhāng méi yǒu jià zhí
sents.en: This article is of no value.

sents.zh: 养大一个宝宝是一项艰难的工作。
sents.p: yǎng dà yī gè bǎo bao shì yī xiàng jiān nán de gōng zuò
sents.en: Bringing up a baby is hard work.

sents.zh: 自那以后他便过起了艰难的生活。
sents.p: zì nà yǐ hòu tā biàn guò qǐ le jiān nán de shēng huó
sents.en: He led a hard life after that.

sents.zh: 纯真是一件美好的事。
sents.p: chún zhēn shì yī jiàn měi hǎo de shì
sents.en: Innocence is a beautiful thing.

sents.zh: 那个发现纯属偶然。
sents.p: nà gè fā xiàn chún shǔ ǒu rán
sents.en: That discovery was quite accidental.

sents.zh: 我怀孕四个月了。
sents.p: wǒ huái yùn sì gè yuè le
sents.en: I'm four months pregnant.

ex.zh: 她抛弃了她的孩子。

ex.zh: 事实显而易见。

ex.en: The facts are clear.

ex.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

ex.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?

ex.zh: 马倒下时脖子断了。
ex.p: mǎ dǎo xià shí bó zi duàn le
ex.en: The horse broke its neck when it fell.

ex.zh: 我的脖子还疼。
ex.p: wǒ de bó zi hái téng
ex.en: My neck still hurts.

ex.zh: 她的生活很寂寞。
ex.p: tā de shēng huó hěn jì mò

ex.zh: 他们要求马上把国王处死。

items.en: to publish; to issue (stocks, currency etc)

ex.zh: 王子继承了王位。

ex.zh: 我见到了王子真人。

ex.en: I met the prince himself.

ex.zh: 口香糖粘到他的鞋子上了。

ex.en: Some gum stuck to his shoes.

ex.zh: 你头发上粘着什么东西。
ex.p: nǐ tóu fa shàng zhān zhe shén me dōng xi
ex.en: There's something in your hair.

ex.zh: 那不是一颗真正的钻石，对吗？

ex.en: That's not a real diamond, is it?

ex.zh: 这颗钻石不是真的。

ex.en: This diamond isn't real.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第112单元

Psychology and behavior

Grammar focus: 不免; 未必; 反而

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

units.title: Psychology and behavior
units.intro: Grammar focus: 不免; 未必; 反而

ex.zh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
ex.p: yǒu le jiān dìng de mù biāo nǐ huì zuò de hěn hǎo
ex.en: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.

ex.zh: 我或许可以修好它。
ex.p: wǒ huò xǔ kě yǐ xiū hǎo tā
ex.en: I might be able to fix that.

ex.zh: 这场灾难的唯一幸存者是一个婴儿。
ex.p: zhè chǎng zāi nàn de wéi yī xìng cún zhě shì yī gè yīng ér
ex.en: The accident's only survivor was a baby.

ex.zh: 画这幅画的时候你脑海中浮现出了什么图像？
ex.p: huà zhè fú huà de shí hou nǐ nǎo hǎi zhōng fú xiàn chū le shén me tú xiàng
ex.en: What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?

items.en: to tease (playfully); to entice; (coll.) to joke

ex.zh: 我被你逗乐了。
ex.p: wǒ bèi nǐ dòu lè le
ex.en: You made me laugh.

ex.zh: 这个坏掉的花瓶无法修复了。
ex.p: zhè gè huài diào de huā píng wú fǎ xiū fù le
ex.en: This broken vase can't be repaired.

items.en: to depend on; to be dependent on

ex.zh: 不要太过于依赖别人。
ex.p: bù yào tài guò yú yī lài bié ren
ex.en: Don't depend too much on others.

ex.zh: 人们正在依赖着我们。
ex.p: rén men zhèng zài yī lài zhe wǒ men
ex.en: People are counting on us.

ex.zh: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。
ex.p: nǐ měi cì dōu jì xù fàn tóng yàng de cuò wù
ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.

ex.zh: 他误认为我是一个英国人。
ex.p: tā wù rèn wéi wǒ shì yī gè yīng guó rén
ex.en: He took me for an Englishman.

ex.zh: 给你添麻烦了，真的非常抱歉。
ex.p: gěi nǐ tiān má fan le zhēn de fēi cháng bào qiàn
ex.en: I'm very sorry to have troubled you.

ex.zh: 我们不想给你添麻烦。
ex.p: wǒ men bù xiǎng gěi nǐ tiān má fan
ex.en: We don't want to cause you any trouble.

ex.zh: 他履行了他的承诺，并且帮助了他的兄弟。
ex.p: tā lǚ xíng le tā de chéng nuò bìng qiě bāng zhù le tā de xiōng dì
ex.en: He kept his promise and helped his brothers.

ex.zh: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba cān jiā le liào lǐ jìng sài bìng dé le dì yī míng
ex.en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.

items.en: to be compelled; to be forced

ex.zh: 他们被迫杀掉他们的几匹马来吃。
ex.p: tā men bèi pò shā diào tā men de jǐ pǐ mǎ lái chī
ex.en: They were forced to kill and eat several of their horses.

items.en: to flee from sth; to run away

ex.zh: 我会帮你逃跑的。
ex.p: wǒ huì bāng nǐ táo pǎo de
ex.en: I'll help you escape.

ex.zh: 法律面前人人平等。
ex.p: fǎ lǜ miàn qián rén rén píng děng
ex.en: Everyone is equal before the law.

ex.zh: 人人生来平等。
ex.p: rén rén shēng lái píng děng
ex.en: All men are created equal.

ex.zh: 他在众人面前被嘲笑。
ex.p: tā zài zhòng rén miàn qián bèi cháo xiào
ex.en: He was laughed at in public.

ex.zh: 观众人数庞大。
ex.p: guān zhòng rén shù páng dà
ex.en: The audience was very large.

items.en: to hint; to suggest; hint; suggestion

ex.zh: 你是不是想暗示什么？
ex.p: nǐ shì bù shì xiǎng àn shì shén me
ex.en: Are you implying something?

ex.zh: 你到底想暗示什么？
ex.p: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng àn shì shén me
ex.en: What in the world are you getting at?

ex.zh: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。
ex.p: yǒu yī fēn zhōng de chén mò rán hòu měi gè rén dōu kāi shǐ jiān jiào
ex.en: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.

ex.zh: 它在我的舌尖上。
ex.p: tā zài wǒ de shé jiān shàng
ex.en: It's on the tip of my tongue.

ex.zh: 箭头表示行进方向。
ex.p: jiàn tóu biǎo shì xíng jìn fāng xiàng
ex.en: The arrow indicates the way to go.

ex.zh: 我们那时在谈论事情，但我不记得是什么了。
ex.p: wǒ men nà shí zài tán lùn shì qing dàn wǒ bù jì de shì shén me le
ex.en: We were talking about something at that time, but I don't remember what.

ex.zh: 我不想谈论这个问题。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng tán lùn zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: I don't want to talk about it.

ex.zh: 没有任何干净的盘子。
ex.p: méi yǒu rèn hé gān jìng de pán zi
ex.en: There are no clean plates.

ex.zh: 小屋干净又整洁。
ex.p: xiǎo wū gān jìng yòu zhěng jié
ex.en: The cottage was clean and tidy.

ex.zh: 我们是为了死亡而诞生的。
ex.p: wǒ men shì wèi le sǐ wáng ér dàn shēng de
ex.en: We were born to die.

ex.zh: 不要再夸张了。
ex.p: bù yào zài kuā zhāng le
ex.en: Don't exaggerate.

ex.zh: 我们没机会赢那些一流选手。
ex.p: wǒ men méi jī huì yíng nà xiē yī liú xuǎn shǒu
ex.en: We have no chance against those top players.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第113单元

Psychology and behavior

Grammar focus: 不免; 未必; 反而

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
sents.p: yǒu le jiān dìng de mù biāo nǐ huì zuò de hěn hǎo
sents.en: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.

sents.zh: 我或许可以修好它。
sents.p: wǒ huò xǔ kě yǐ xiū hǎo tā
sents.en: I might be able to fix that.

sents.zh: 这场灾难的唯一幸存者是一个婴儿。
sents.p: zhè chǎng zāi nàn de wéi yī xìng cún zhě shì yī gè yīng ér
sents.en: The accident's only survivor was a baby.

sents.zh: 画这幅画的时候你脑海中浮现出了什么图像？
sents.p: huà zhè fú huà de shí hou nǐ nǎo hǎi zhōng fú xiàn chū le shén me tú xiàng
sents.en: What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?

sents.zh: 我被你逗乐了。
sents.p: wǒ bèi nǐ dòu lè le
sents.en: You made me laugh.

sents.zh: 这个坏掉的花瓶无法修复了。
sents.p: zhè gè huài diào de huā píng wú fǎ xiū fù le
sents.en: This broken vase can't be repaired.

sents.zh: 不要太过于依赖别人。
sents.p: bù yào tài guò yú yī lài bié ren
sents.en: Don't depend too much on others.

sents.zh: 人们正在依赖着我们。
sents.p: rén men zhèng zài yī lài zhe wǒ men
sents.en: People are counting on us.

sents.zh: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。
sents.p: nǐ měi cì dōu jì xù fàn tóng yàng de cuò wù
sents.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.

sents.zh: 他误认为我是一个英国人。
sents.p: tā wù rèn wéi wǒ shì yī gè yīng guó rén
sents.en: He took me for an Englishman.

sents.zh: 给你添麻烦了，真的非常抱歉。
sents.p: gěi nǐ tiān má fan le zhēn de fēi cháng bào qiàn
sents.en: I'm very sorry to have troubled you.

sents.zh: 我们不想给你添麻烦。
sents.p: wǒ men bù xiǎng gěi nǐ tiān má fan
sents.en: We don't want to cause you any trouble.

sents.zh: 他履行了他的承诺，并且帮助了他的兄弟。
sents.p: tā lǚ xíng le tā de chéng nuò bìng qiě bāng zhù le tā de xiōng dì
sents.en: He kept his promise and helped his brothers.

sents.zh: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba cān jiā le liào lǐ jìng sài bìng dé le dì yī míng
sents.en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.

sents.zh: 他们被迫杀掉他们的几匹马来吃。
sents.p: tā men bèi pò shā diào tā men de jǐ pǐ mǎ lái chī
sents.en: They were forced to kill and eat several of their horses.

sents.zh: 我会帮你逃跑的。
sents.p: wǒ huì bāng nǐ táo pǎo de
sents.en: I'll help you escape.

sents.zh: 法律面前人人平等。
sents.p: fǎ lǜ miàn qián rén rén píng děng
sents.en: Everyone is equal before the law.

sents.zh: 人人生来平等。
sents.p: rén rén shēng lái píng děng
sents.en: All men are created equal.

sents.zh: 他在众人面前被嘲笑。
sents.p: tā zài zhòng rén miàn qián bèi cháo xiào
sents.en: He was laughed at in public.

sents.zh: 观众人数庞大。
sents.p: guān zhòng rén shù páng dà
sents.en: The audience was very large.

sents.zh: 你是不是想暗示什么？
sents.p: nǐ shì bù shì xiǎng àn shì shén me
sents.en: Are you implying something?

sents.zh: 你到底想暗示什么？
sents.p: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng àn shì shén me
sents.en: What in the world are you getting at?

sents.zh: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。
sents.p: yǒu yī fēn zhōng de chén mò rán hòu měi gè rén dōu kāi shǐ jiān jiào
sents.en: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.

sents.zh: 它在我的舌尖上。
sents.p: tā zài wǒ de shé jiān shàng
sents.en: It's on the tip of my tongue.

sents.zh: 箭头表示行进方向。
sents.p: jiàn tóu biǎo shì xíng jìn fāng xiàng
sents.en: The arrow indicates the way to go.

sents.zh: 我们那时在谈论事情，但我不记得是什么了。
sents.p: wǒ men nà shí zài tán lùn shì qing dàn wǒ bù jì de shì shén me le
sents.en: We were talking about something at that time, but I don't remember what.

sents.zh: 我不想谈论这个问题。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng tán lùn zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: I don't want to talk about it.

sents.zh: 没有任何干净的盘子。
sents.p: méi yǒu rèn hé gān jìng de pán zi
sents.en: There are no clean plates.

sents.zh: 小屋干净又整洁。
sents.p: xiǎo wū gān jìng yòu zhěng jié
sents.en: The cottage was clean and tidy.

sents.zh: 我们是为了死亡而诞生的。
sents.p: wǒ men shì wèi le sǐ wáng ér dàn shēng de
sents.en: We were born to die.

sents.zh: 不要再夸张了。
sents.p: bù yào zài kuā zhāng le
sents.en: Don't exaggerate.

sents.zh: 我们没机会赢那些一流选手。
sents.p: wǒ men méi jī huì yíng nà xiē yī liú xuǎn shǒu
sents.en: We have no chance against those top players.

units.title: Psychology and behavior
units.intro: Grammar focus: 不免; 未必; 反而

items.en: to fish out (from pocket); to scoop

ex.zh: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。
ex.p: cóng tā de wài biǎo lái kàn tā yīng gāi shì gè yǒu qián rén
ex.en: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.

ex.zh: 外表并不是全部。
ex.p: wài biǎo bìng bù shì quán bù
ex.en: Looks aren't everything.

ex.zh: 我从窗口爬进来的。
ex.p: wǒ cóng chuāng kǒu pá jìn lái de
ex.en: I climbed in through the window.

ex.zh: 不是每个人都是老实的。
ex.p: bù shì měi gè rén dōu shì lǎo shi de
ex.en: Not everyone is honest.

ex.zh: 你看起来像个老实人。
ex.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai xiàng gè lǎo shi rén
ex.en: You seem to be an honest man.

ex.zh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn qíng shàng zhī chí dàn shì lǐ xìng shàng fǎn duì
ex.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.

items.en: to contribute (as a gift); to donate
to discuss; to converse; chat; discussion

ex.zh: 大概我们需要交谈。
ex.p: dà gài wǒ men xū yào jiāo tán
ex.en: Maybe we should talk.

ex.zh: 我和朋友们交谈。
ex.p: wǒ hé péng you men jiāo tán
ex.en: I talked to friends.

ex.zh: 我无法取代她做英语老师。
ex.p: wǒ wú fǎ qǔ dài tā zuò yīng yǔ lǎo shī
ex.en: I can't take the place of her as an English teacher.

ex.zh: 和他争论这件事得不出结果。
ex.p: hé tā zhēng lùn zhè jiàn shì de bù chū jié guǒ
ex.en: It is no use arguing with him about it.

ex.zh: 我们别再浪费时间争论了。
ex.p: wǒ men bié zài làng fèi shí jiān zhēng lùn le
ex.en: Let's not waste time arguing about it.

ex.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。
ex.p: wǒ hài xiū de bù gǎn zhèng miàn kàn tā de liǎn
ex.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.

ex.zh: 我对此毫不怀疑。
ex.p: wǒ duì cǐ háo bù huái yí
ex.en: I don't doubt it in the least.

ex.zh: 我们毫不费力地想出了密码。
ex.p: wǒ men háo bù fèi lì de xiǎng chū le mì mǎ
ex.en: We easily figured out the password.

ex.zh: 住在隔壁的男孩常常很晚回来。
ex.p: zhù zài gé bì de nán hái cháng cháng hěn wǎn huí lai
ex.en: The boy who lives next door often comes home late.

ex.zh: 隔壁的男孩常常晚回家。
ex.p: gé bì de nán hái cháng cháng wǎn huí jiā
ex.en: The boy who lives next door often comes home late.

items.en: generic term for cotton or kapok; cotton

ex.zh: 有一天我买了一台棉花糖机。
ex.p: yǒu yī tiān wǒ mǎi le yī tái mián hua táng jī
ex.en: Someday I'll buy a cotton candy machine.

ex.zh: 你应该做一个外交官。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi zuò yī gè wài jiāo guān
ex.en: You should be a diplomat.

ex.zh: 外交官有多种特权。
ex.p: wài jiāo guān yǒu duō zhǒng tè quán
ex.en: Diplomats are allowed various privileges.

items.en: to look after; to take into consideration

ex.zh: 要是我死了，谁来照顾我的孩子们？
ex.p: yào shi wǒ sǐ le shéi lái zhào gu wǒ de hái zi men
ex.en: Were I to die, who would look after my children?

ex.zh: 你要做的只是照顾好你自己。
ex.p: nǐ yào zuò de zhǐ shì zhào gu hǎo nǐ zì jǐ
ex.en: All you have to do is to take care of yourself.

ex.zh: 他给自己定下每天早上散步的规矩。
ex.p: tā gěi zì jǐ dìng xià měi tiān zǎo shang sàn bù de guī ju
ex.en: He makes it a rule to take a walk every morning.

ex.zh: 我有时候打破规矩。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu shí hou dǎ pò guī ju
ex.en: I sometimes break the rules.

ex.zh: 大使被从华沙召回。
ex.p: dà shǐ bèi cóng huá shā zhào huí
ex.en: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.

ex.zh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。
ex.p: tā shì měi guó dà shǐ guǎn de wài jiāo guān
ex.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.

items.en: at the scene; on the spot

ex.zh: 你怎么看待这件事？
ex.p: nǐ zěn me kàn dài zhè jiàn shì
ex.en: What do you think about this?

ex.zh: 讨论最后变成了打架。
ex.p: tǎo lùn zuì hòu biàn chéng le dǎ jià
ex.en: The argument ended in a fight.

ex.zh: 你们为什么老打架？
ex.p: nǐ men wèi shén me lǎo dǎ jià
ex.en: Why do you guys always fight?

ex.zh: 我不再是你的助手了。
ex.p: wǒ bù zài shì nǐ de zhù shǒu le
ex.en: I'm no longer your assistant.

items.en: able to; so that sb can
to hit the market (of a new product); to float

ex.zh: 我理所当然地认为她会参加我们的结婚典礼。
ex.p: wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán de rèn wéi tā huì cān jiā wǒ men de jié hūn diǎn lǐ
ex.en: I took it for granted that she would come to our wedding.

ex.zh: 我不想参加典礼。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng cān jiā diǎn lǐ
ex.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.

ex.zh: 船被安全地领入港口。
ex.p: chuán bèi ān quán de lǐng rù gǎng kǒu
ex.en: The boat was piloted safely into harbor.

sents.zh: 他给自己定下每天早上散步的规矩。
sents.p: tā gěi zì jǐ dìng xià měi tiān zǎo shang sàn bù de guī ju
sents.en: He makes it a rule to take a walk every morning.

sents.zh: 我有时候打破规矩。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu shí hou dǎ pò guī ju
sents.en: I sometimes break the rules.

sents.zh: 大使被从华沙召回。
sents.p: dà shǐ bèi cóng huá shā zhào huí
sents.en: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.

sents.zh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。
sents.p: tā shì měi guó dà shǐ guǎn de wài jiāo guān
sents.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.

sents.zh: 你怎么看待这件事？
sents.p: nǐ zěn me kàn dài zhè jiàn shì
sents.en: What do you think about this?

sents.zh: 讨论最后变成了打架。
sents.p: tǎo lùn zuì hòu biàn chéng le dǎ jià
sents.en: The argument ended in a fight.

sents.zh: 你们为什么老打架？
sents.p: nǐ men wèi shén me lǎo dǎ jià
sents.en: Why do you guys always fight?

sents.zh: 我不再是你的助手了。
sents.p: wǒ bù zài shì nǐ de zhù shǒu le
sents.en: I'm no longer your assistant.

sents.zh: 我理所当然地认为她会参加我们的结婚典礼。
sents.p: wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán de rèn wéi tā huì cān jiā wǒ men de jié hūn diǎn lǐ
sents.en: I took it for granted that she would come to our wedding.

sents.zh: 我不想参加典礼。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng cān jiā diǎn lǐ
sents.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.

sents.zh: 船被安全地领入港口。
sents.p: chuán bèi ān quán de lǐng rù gǎng kǒu
sents.en: The boat was piloted safely into harbor.

Business and management
