units.intro: Grammar focus: Report language; 鉴于; 至于

ex.zh: 我很惊讶你竟然那么天真。
ex.p: wǒ hěn jīng yà nǐ jìng rán nà me tiān zhēn
ex.en: I'm surprised you're so naive.

ex.zh: 他们都是天真的孩子。
ex.p: tā men dōu shì tiān zhēn de hái zi
ex.en: They're all innocent children.

items.en: outer surface; the outside of sth
to drape over one's shoulders; to open

ex.zh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
ex.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shàng wǒ rèn tóng nǐ suǒ shuō de
ex.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.

items.en: line of thought; way of thinking

ex.zh: 我的车在事故中受到严重损坏
ex.p: wǒ de chē zài shì gù zhōng shòu dào yán zhòng sǔn huài
ex.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.

ex.zh: 这场暴风雪已经对经济造成了很严重的影响。
ex.p: zhè chǎng bào fēng xuě yǐ jīng duì jīng jì zào chéng le hěn yán zhòng de yǐng xiǎng
ex.en: The storm had a serious effect on the economy.

ex.zh: 您知道您的尺寸吗？
ex.p: nín zhī dào nín de chǐ cun ma
ex.en: Do you know your size?

ex.zh: 我们有你的尺寸，但是没有那个颜色。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu nǐ de chǐ cun dàn shì méi yǒu nà gè yán sè
ex.en: We have your size, but not in that color.

ex.zh: 她害怕自己的影子。
ex.p: tā hài pà zì jǐ de yǐng zi
ex.en: She is afraid of her own shadow.

ex.zh: 他怕自己的影子。
ex.p: tā pà zì jǐ de yǐng zi
ex.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.

ex.zh: 他的村屋在海岸上。
ex.p: tā de cūn wū zài hǎi àn shàng
ex.en: His cottage is on the coast.

ex.zh: 她大方地道歉。
ex.p: tā dà fāng dì dao qiàn
ex.en: She had the decency to apologize.

items.en: to take a step; to stride

ex.zh: 我们为她的安全担忧。
ex.p: wǒ men wèi tā de ān quán dān yōu
ex.en: We are anxious about her safety.

ex.zh: 嫌疑人是一位白人女性。
ex.p: xián yí rén shì yī wèi bái rén nǚ xìng
ex.en: The suspect is a caucasian female.

ex.zh: 嫌疑犯目前性别不明。
ex.p: xián yí fàn mù qián xìng bié bù míng
ex.en: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.

ex.zh: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。
ex.p: nà jiù shì wǒ bù zàn tóng nǐ de jì huà de yuán yīn
ex.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.

ex.zh: 在这件事上，我无法赞同你。
ex.p: zài zhè jiàn shì shàng wǒ wú fǎ zàn tóng nǐ
ex.en: I cannot agree with you on the matter.

items.en: to inspect; to observe and study

ex.zh: 这个理论很有争议。
ex.p: zhè gè lǐ lùn hěn yǒu zhēng yì
ex.en: This theory is very controversial.

ex.zh: 你只会逃避生活问题。
ex.p: nǐ zhǐ huì táo bì shēng huó wèn tí
ex.en: You're just running away from life's problems.

ex.zh: 没人能逃避死亡。
ex.p: méi rén néng táo bì sǐ wáng
ex.en: Nobody can avoid death.

ex.zh: 我想成为决策的人。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi jué cè de rén
ex.en: I want to be the one who decides.

ex.zh: 我能预定一下打高尔夫球吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng yù dìng yī xià dǎ gāo ěr fū qiú ma
ex.en: Can I make a reservation for golf?

ex.zh: 我没有预定这个。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yù dìng zhè gè
ex.en: I didn't order this.

ex.zh: 这鸟你们用英语怎么称呼？
ex.p: zhè niǎo nǐ men yòng yīng yǔ zěn me chēng hu
ex.en: What do you call this bird in English?

ex.zh: 不要因为他犯了一个错误就嘲笑他。
ex.p: bù yào yīn wèi tā fàn le yī gè cuò wù jiù cháo xiào tā
ex.en: Don't laugh at him for making a mistake.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢你嘲笑她的方式。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan nǐ cháo xiào tā de fāng shì
ex.en: I don't like the way you laugh at her.

items.en: meaning (implicit in a phrase); implied meaning

ex.zh: 这个词有两种含义。
ex.p: zhè gè cí yǒu liǎng zhǒng hán yì
ex.en: This word has two meanings.

ex.zh: 这辆车需要清洗。
ex.p: zhè liàng chē xū yào qīng xǐ
ex.en: This car needs washed.

ex.zh: 空气是气体的混合物。
ex.p: kōng qì shì qì tǐ de hùn hé wù
ex.en: Air is a mixture of gases.

items.en: to clasp; to cup the hands

ex.zh: 他们服从了命令。
ex.p: tā men fú cóng le mìng lìng
ex.en: They obeyed orders.

ex.zh: 他们并不总是服从父母。
ex.p: tā men bìng bù zǒng shì fú cóng fù mǔ
ex.en: They don't always obey their parents.

items.en: to do with difficulty; to force sb to do sth

ex.zh: 这儿有张德国的大地图。
ex.p: zhèr yǒu zhāng dé guó de dà dì tú
ex.en: Here's a big map of Germany.

ex.zh: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。
ex.p: diàn nǎo kě yǐ zuò jí wéi fù zá de gōng zuò
ex.en: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.

ex.zh: 我们的花园布满了杂草。
ex.p: wǒ men de huā yuán bù mǎn le zá cǎo
ex.en: Our garden was full of weeds.

ex.zh: 不要捉弄老人家。
ex.p: bù yào zhuō nòng lǎo rén jiā
ex.en: Don't make fun of old people.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第116单元

Business and management

Grammar focus: Report language; 鉴于; 至于

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我很惊讶你竟然那么天真。
sents.p: wǒ hěn jīng yà nǐ jìng rán nà me tiān zhēn
sents.en: I'm surprised you're so naive.

sents.zh: 他们都是天真的孩子。
sents.p: tā men dōu shì tiān zhēn de hái zi
sents.en: They're all innocent children.

sents.zh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
sents.p: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shàng wǒ rèn tóng nǐ suǒ shuō de
sents.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.

sents.zh: 我的车在事故中受到严重损坏
sents.p: wǒ de chē zài shì gù zhōng shòu dào yán zhòng sǔn huài
sents.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.

sents.zh: 这场暴风雪已经对经济造成了很严重的影响。
sents.p: zhè chǎng bào fēng xuě yǐ jīng duì jīng jì zào chéng le hěn yán zhòng de yǐng xiǎng
sents.en: The storm had a serious effect on the economy.

sents.zh: 您知道您的尺寸吗？
sents.p: nín zhī dào nín de chǐ cun ma
sents.en: Do you know your size?

sents.zh: 我们有你的尺寸，但是没有那个颜色。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu nǐ de chǐ cun dàn shì méi yǒu nà gè yán sè
sents.en: We have your size, but not in that color.

sents.zh: 她害怕自己的影子。
sents.p: tā hài pà zì jǐ de yǐng zi
sents.en: She is afraid of her own shadow.

sents.zh: 他怕自己的影子。
sents.p: tā pà zì jǐ de yǐng zi
sents.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.

sents.zh: 他的村屋在海岸上。
sents.p: tā de cūn wū zài hǎi àn shàng
sents.en: His cottage is on the coast.

sents.zh: 她大方地道歉。
sents.p: tā dà fāng dì dao qiàn
sents.en: She had the decency to apologize.

sents.zh: 我们为她的安全担忧。
sents.p: wǒ men wèi tā de ān quán dān yōu
sents.en: We are anxious about her safety.

sents.zh: 嫌疑人是一位白人女性。
sents.p: xián yí rén shì yī wèi bái rén nǚ xìng
sents.en: The suspect is a caucasian female.

sents.zh: 嫌疑犯目前性别不明。
sents.p: xián yí fàn mù qián xìng bié bù míng
sents.en: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.

sents.zh: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。
sents.p: nà jiù shì wǒ bù zàn tóng nǐ de jì huà de yuán yīn
sents.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.

sents.zh: 在这件事上，我无法赞同你。
sents.p: zài zhè jiàn shì shàng wǒ wú fǎ zàn tóng nǐ
sents.en: I cannot agree with you on the matter.

sents.zh: 这个理论很有争议。
sents.p: zhè gè lǐ lùn hěn yǒu zhēng yì
sents.en: This theory is very controversial.

sents.zh: 你只会逃避生活问题。
sents.p: nǐ zhǐ huì táo bì shēng huó wèn tí
sents.en: You're just running away from life's problems.

sents.zh: 没人能逃避死亡。
sents.p: méi rén néng táo bì sǐ wáng
sents.en: Nobody can avoid death.

sents.zh: 我想成为决策的人。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi jué cè de rén
sents.en: I want to be the one who decides.

sents.zh: 我能预定一下打高尔夫球吗？
sents.p: wǒ néng yù dìng yī xià dǎ gāo ěr fū qiú ma
sents.en: Can I make a reservation for golf?

sents.zh: 我没有预定这个。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu yù dìng zhè gè
sents.en: I didn't order this.

sents.zh: 这鸟你们用英语怎么称呼？
sents.p: zhè niǎo nǐ men yòng yīng yǔ zěn me chēng hu
sents.en: What do you call this bird in English?

sents.zh: 不要因为他犯了一个错误就嘲笑他。
sents.p: bù yào yīn wèi tā fàn le yī gè cuò wù jiù cháo xiào tā
sents.en: Don't laugh at him for making a mistake.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢你嘲笑她的方式。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan nǐ cháo xiào tā de fāng shì
sents.en: I don't like the way you laugh at her.

sents.zh: 这个词有两种含义。
sents.p: zhè gè cí yǒu liǎng zhǒng hán yì
sents.en: This word has two meanings.

sents.zh: 这辆车需要清洗。
sents.p: zhè liàng chē xū yào qīng xǐ
sents.en: This car needs washed.

sents.zh: 空气是气体的混合物。
sents.p: kōng qì shì qì tǐ de hùn hé wù
sents.en: Air is a mixture of gases.

sents.zh: 他们服从了命令。
sents.p: tā men fú cóng le mìng lìng
sents.en: They obeyed orders.

sents.zh: 他们并不总是服从父母。
sents.p: tā men bìng bù zǒng shì fú cóng fù mǔ
sents.en: They don't always obey their parents.

sents.zh: 这儿有张德国的大地图。
sents.p: zhèr yǒu zhāng dé guó de dà dì tú
sents.en: Here's a big map of Germany.

sents.zh: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。
sents.p: diàn nǎo kě yǐ zuò jí wéi fù zá de gōng zuò
sents.en: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.

sents.zh: 我们的花园布满了杂草。
sents.p: wǒ men de huā yuán bù mǎn le zá cǎo
sents.en: Our garden was full of weeds.

sents.zh: 不要捉弄老人家。
sents.p: bù yào zhuō nòng lǎo rén jiā
sents.en: Don't make fun of old people.

units.intro: Grammar focus: Report language; 鉴于; 至于

ex.zh: 闪电照亮了天空。
ex.p: shǎn diàn zhào liàng le tiān kōng
ex.en: The lightning lit up the sky.

items.en: to perform on a musical instrument

ex.zh: 这首曲子对我来说太难演奏了。
ex.p: zhè shǒu qǔ zi duì wǒ lái shuō tài nán yǎn zòu le
ex.en: This piece of music is way too difficult for me to play.

ex.zh: 她小提琴演奏得非常好。
ex.p: tā xiǎo tí qín yǎn zòu de fēi cháng hǎo
ex.en: She plays the violin very well.

ex.zh: 如果我中了彩票，我会买辆新车。
ex.p: rú guǒ wǒ zhōng le cǎi piào wǒ huì mǎi liàng xīn chē
ex.en: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a new car.

ex.zh: 你买彩票了吗？
ex.p: nǐ mǎi cǎi piào le ma
ex.en: Have you bought a raffle ticket yet?

ex.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
ex.p: jìn lái kā fēi de duǎn quē zào chéng le xǔ duō wèn tí
ex.en: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.

ex.zh: 他拿了面镜子细看自己的舌头。
ex.p: tā ná le miàn jìng zi xì kàn zì jǐ de shé tou
ex.en: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.

items.en: to donate money; to contribute funds

ex.zh: 你每天早上都刮胡子吗？
ex.p: nǐ měi tiān zǎo shang dōu guā hú zi ma
ex.en: Do you shave every morning?

ex.zh: 他刮了他的胡子。
ex.p: tā guā le tā de hú zi
ex.en: He shaved his mustache off.

items.en: the most important; of chief importance

ex.zh: 恶劣的天气对他的健康带来了影响。
ex.p: è liè de tiān qì duì tā de jiàn kāng dài lái le yǐng xiǎng
ex.en: The bad weather affected his health.

ex.zh: 茶点过后我们接着开会。
ex.p: chá diǎn guò hòu wǒ men jiē zhe kāi huì
ex.en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.

ex.zh: 我今天无法给您一个最终的答复。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān wú fǎ gěi nín yī gè zuì zhōng de dá fù
ex.en: I cannot give you a definite answer today.

ex.zh: 谢谢你的答复。
ex.p: xiè xie nǐ de dá fù
ex.en: Thanks for your reply.

ex.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。
ex.p: yín háng duì fēng xiǎn kè hù shōu qǔ jiào gāo de dài kuǎn lì xī
ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.

items.en: to give emergency treatment; first aid

ex.zh: 别忘了带上急救箱。
ex.p: bié wàng le dài shàng jí jiù xiāng
ex.en: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.

ex.zh: 您吃不吃辣椒？
ex.p: nín chī bù chī là jiāo
ex.en: Do you want pepper on it?

ex.zh: 能在日本找到这样的大的院子实属罕见。
ex.p: néng zài rì běn zhǎo dào zhè yàng de dà de yuàn zi shí shǔ hǎn jiàn
ex.en: It's rare to find big yards in Japan.

ex.zh: 今年的时尚潮流完全不同于去年。
ex.p: jīn nián de shí shàng cháo liú wán quán bù tóng yú qù nián
ex.en: This year's fashions are completely different from last year's.

ex.zh: 跟上最近潮流时尚是件非常花钱的事儿。
ex.p: gēn shàng zuì jìn cháo liú shí shàng shì jiàn fēi cháng huā qián de shì ér
ex.en: It is very expensive to keep up with the latest fashions.

ex.zh: 我哥住在一座小村庄里。
ex.p: wǒ gē zhù zài yī zuò xiǎo cūn zhuāng lǐ
ex.en: My brother lives in a small village.

ex.zh: 我天黑之前到达了村庄。
ex.p: wǒ tiān hēi zhī qián dào dá le cūn zhuāng
ex.en: I arrived at the village before dark.

ex.zh: 他的演说打动了我们。
ex.p: tā de yǎn shuō dǎ dòng le wǒ men
ex.en: His speech moved us.

ex.zh: 她一直和她的兄弟争吵。
ex.p: tā yī zhí hé tā de xiōng dì zhēng chǎo
ex.en: She was always quarreling with her brothers.

ex.zh: 他们争吵后，一周都没有再说话。
ex.p: tā men zhēng chǎo hòu yī zhōu dōu méi yǒu zài shuō huà
ex.en: After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.

ex.zh: 过去，我父亲常常喝酒直到深夜。
ex.p: guò qù wǒ fù qīn cháng cháng hē jiǔ zhí dào shēn yè
ex.en: My father used to drink till late at night.

items.en: to cut short; to break off
to pay a visit; to call on

ex.zh: 我没有拜访他，因为我感冒了。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu bài fǎng tā yīn wèi wǒ gǎn mào le

units.intro: Grammar focus: Report language; 鉴于; 至于

ex.zh: 这两张图片之间有细致的差异。
ex.p: zhè liǎng zhāng tú piàn zhī jiān yǒu xì zhì de chā yì
ex.en: There are subtle differences between the two pictures.

ex.zh: 这是什么气味？
ex.p: zhè shì shén me qì wèi
ex.en: What's this smell?

items.en: to ignite; to set on fire
to think of; to long for

ex.zh: 他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。
ex.p: tā zhuàng chē shì yīn wèi yǒu rén zài shā chē shàng zuò le shǒu jiǎo
ex.en: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.

ex.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。
ex.p: chú fēi tā men shì xiān xiū hǎo shā chē wǒ cái huì mǎi chē zǐ
ex.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.

items.en: to rest; to take a break

ex.zh: 英语有很多法语外来词。
ex.p: yīng yǔ yǒu hěn duō fǎ yǔ wài lái cí
ex.en: English has many loan words from French.

ex.zh: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
ex.p: xué sheng men zài tàn tǎo yǔ yán hé wén huà
ex.en: The students are talking about language and culture.

items.en: student; member of an institution of learning
to focus; to concentrate; to give one's full att

ex.zh: 她专注在她的新工作上。
ex.p: tā zhuān zhù zài tā de xīn gōng zuò shàng
ex.en: She applied her mind to her new job.

ex.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
ex.p: zhè bù shì yī gè lòu dòng ér shì yī gè méi yǒu xiě jìn wén dàng de tè xìng
ex.en: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.

ex.zh: 货物毫无损坏地到达了。
ex.p: huò wù háo wú sǔn huài de dào dá le
ex.en: The goods arrived undamaged.

ex.zh: 我的车在事故中受到严重损坏
ex.p: wǒ de chē zài shì gù zhōng shòu dào yán zhòng sǔn huài
ex.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.

items.en: to inspect and verify; experimental verification

ex.zh: 实验证明了他的理论。
ex.p: shí yàn zhèng míng le tā de lǐ lùn
ex.en: The experiment confirmed his theory.

ex.zh: 他把感冒传染给我了。
ex.p: tā bǎ gǎn mào chuán rǎn gěi wǒ le
ex.en: He gave me a cold.

ex.zh: 我能听见鸟在窗外歌唱。
ex.p: wǒ néng tīng jiàn niǎo zài chuāng wài gē chàng
ex.en: I could hear birds singing outside my window.

items.en: to request help; to appeal (for help)

ex.zh: 她向我们大声求助。
ex.p: tā xiàng wǒ men dà shēng qiú zhù
ex.en: She called out to us for help.

ex.zh: 你可以向他求助。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiàng tā qiú zhù
ex.en: You can ask him for help.

items.en: to work a shift; on duty
to hold in safekeeping; to have in one's care

ex.zh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。
ex.p: yào shi nǐ lǎo dǎ yóu xì de huà nǐ de shì lì huì xià jiàng de
ex.en: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.

ex.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
ex.p: zhè xiē tiān wǒ de shì lì zhèng zài biàn chà
ex.en: My vision is getting worse these days.

ex.zh: 我的家人每年冬天去滑雪。
ex.p: wǒ de jiā rén měi nián dōng tiān qù huá xuě
ex.en: My family goes skiing every winter.

ex.zh: 我之前不怎么想去滑雪。
ex.p: wǒ zhī qián bù zěn me xiǎng qù huá xuě
ex.en: I didn't really feel like going skiing.

sents.p: zhè shì shén me qì wèi
sents.en: What's this smell?

sents.zh: 他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。
sents.p: tā zhuàng chē shì yīn wèi yǒu rén zài shā chē shàng zuò le shǒu jiǎo
sents.en: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.

sents.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。
sents.p: chú fēi tā men shì xiān xiū hǎo shā chē wǒ cái huì mǎi chē zǐ
sents.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.

sents.zh: 英语有很多法语外来词。
sents.p: yīng yǔ yǒu hěn duō fǎ yǔ wài lái cí
sents.en: English has many loan words from French.

sents.zh: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
sents.p: xué sheng men zài tàn tǎo yǔ yán hé wén huà
sents.en: The students are talking about language and culture.

sents.zh: 她专注在她的新工作上。
sents.p: tā zhuān zhù zài tā de xīn gōng zuò shàng
sents.en: She applied her mind to her new job.

sents.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
sents.p: zhè bù shì yī gè lòu dòng ér shì yī gè méi yǒu xiě jìn wén dàng de tè xìng
sents.en: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.

sents.zh: 货物毫无损坏地到达了。
sents.p: huò wù háo wú sǔn huài de dào dá le
sents.en: The goods arrived undamaged.

sents.zh: 我的车在事故中受到严重损坏
sents.p: wǒ de chē zài shì gù zhōng shòu dào yán zhòng sǔn huài
sents.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.

sents.zh: 实验证明了他的理论。
sents.p: shí yàn zhèng míng le tā de lǐ lùn
sents.en: The experiment confirmed his theory.

sents.zh: 他把感冒传染给我了。
sents.p: tā bǎ gǎn mào chuán rǎn gěi wǒ le
sents.en: He gave me a cold.

sents.zh: 我能听见鸟在窗外歌唱。
sents.p: wǒ néng tīng jiàn niǎo zài chuāng wài gē chàng
sents.en: I could hear birds singing outside my window.

sents.zh: 她向我们大声求助。
sents.p: tā xiàng wǒ men dà shēng qiú zhù
sents.en: She called out to us for help.

sents.zh: 你可以向他求助。
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiàng tā qiú zhù
sents.en: You can ask him for help.

sents.zh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。
sents.p: yào shi nǐ lǎo dǎ yóu xì de huà nǐ de shì lì huì xià jiàng de
sents.en: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.

sents.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
sents.p: zhè xiē tiān wǒ de shì lì zhèng zài biàn chà
sents.en: My vision is getting worse these days.

sents.zh: 我的家人每年冬天去滑雪。
sents.p: wǒ de jiā rén měi nián dōng tiān qù huá xuě
sents.en: My family goes skiing every winter.

sents.zh: 我之前不怎么想去滑雪。
sents.p: wǒ zhī qián bù zěn me xiǎng qù huá xuě
sents.en: I didn't really feel like going skiing.

ex.zh: 他的胃口很好。

ex.zh: 多亏你我胃口都没了。
ex.p: duō kuī nǐ wǒ wèi kǒu dōu méi le

items.en: to assist; to aid; supplementary; auxiliary

ex.zh: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。

ex.zh: 我有一个设想。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu yī gè shè xiǎng
ex.en: I had a vision.

ex.zh: 你认为日本第二高峰是哪座山？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi rì běn dì èr gāo fēng shì nǎ zuò shān
ex.en: What mountain do you think is the second highest in Japan?

ex.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
ex.p: yuè qiú shì dì qiú wéi yī de wèi xīng
ex.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.

ex.zh: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。
ex.p: cóng yuè qiú shàng kàn de huà dì qiú kàn qǐ lai xiàng gè pí qiú
ex.en: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.

items.en: to pick up; to collate or arrange

ex.zh: 她经常在饭后收拾桌子。
ex.p: tā jīng cháng zài fàn hòu shōu shi zhuō zi
ex.en: She always clears the table after a meal.

ex.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
ex.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.

ex.zh: 我要一间有淋浴的单人间。
ex.p: wǒ yào yī jiān yǒu lín yù de dān rén jiān
ex.en: I'd like a single with a shower, please.

ex.zh: 我想要冰激淋作甜点。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào bīng jī lín zuō tián diǎn
ex.en: I want ice cream for dessert.

ex.zh: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？
ex.p: nǐ jiàn dào jīn tiān zǎo shang de cǎi hóng le ma
ex.en: Did you see the rainbow this morning?

ex.zh: 有时候，我们应该后退一步想一想。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou wǒ men yīng gāi hòu tuì yī bù xiǎng yī xiǎng
ex.en: Once in a while, we should take a step back and think.

ex.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
ex.p: wǒ bù què dìng gāi qián jìn hái shi hòu tuì
ex.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.

items.en: branch; classifier for sticks, rods, pencils etc

ex.zh: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。
ex.p: nǚ hái gěi le wǒ yī zhī hóng méi guī hé yī zhī bái méi guī
ex.en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.

ex.zh: 他紧紧抓住树枝。
ex.p: tā jǐn jǐn zhuā zhù shù zhī
ex.en: He held on firmly to the branch.

ex.zh: 这次旅途下了三场雨。
ex.p: zhè cì lǚ tú xià le sān chǎng yù
ex.en: It rained three times during the trip.

ex.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。
ex.p: zhù nǐ lǚ tú yú kuài
ex.en: I hope you have a good trip.

ex.zh: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。
ex.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi dé dào tā men gěi nǐ de xīn shuǐ
ex.en: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.

ex.zh: 他的低薪水让他买不了房。
ex.p: tā de dī xīn shuǐ ràng tā mǎi bù liǎo fáng
ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.

items.en: used for 师傅 (in Taiwan); master

ex.zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。
ex.p: méi yǒu rén huì wèi zhè gè jiù jiàn zhù wù de chāi chú ér là lèi
ex.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.

ex.zh: 在建筑物里的所有人都感觉到了地震。
ex.p: zài jiàn zhù wù lǐ de suǒ yǒu rén dōu gǎn jué dào le dì zhèn
ex.en: Everybody in the building felt the earthquake.

items.en: to procure (for an enterprise etc); to purchase

ex.zh: 放眼全球，立足本土。
ex.p: fàng yǎn quán qiú lì zú běn tǔ
ex.en: Think globally, act locally.

ex.zh: 我很疑惑为什么天气变冷的时候我会觉得很孤单。
ex.p: wǒ hěn yí huò wèi shén me tiān qì biàn lěng de shí hou wǒ huì jué de hěn gū dān
ex.en: I wonder why I feel so lonely when it gets cold.

ex.zh: 请给我们两把刀和四把叉。
ex.p: qǐng gěi wǒ men liǎng bǎ dāo hé sì bǎ chā
ex.en: Give us two knives and four forks, please.

ex.zh: 叉子从桌上掉了下来。
ex.p: chā zi cóng zhuō shàng diào le xià lai
ex.en: A fork fell off the table.

ex.zh: 我不能再拖延了。
ex.p: wǒ bù néng zài tuō yán le
ex.en: I have to stop procrastinating.

ex.zh: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiàng wǒ yǐ qián nà me tuō yán le
ex.en: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.

units.title: Literature
units.intro: Grammar focus: Excerpts from public-domain modern writers (鲁迅, 朱自清); classical particles 之, 乎, 者, 也

ex.zh: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。
ex.p: wǒ réng jiù wú fǎ xiāng xìn wǒ jū rán zuò le zhè zhǒng shì
ex.en: I still can't believe I did it.

ex.zh: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
ex.p: yǒu kōng de shí hou wǒ zǒng xǐ huan tīng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè
ex.en: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.

ex.zh: 他够大方，借了我一点钱。
ex.p: tā gòu dà fāng jiè le wǒ yī diǎn qián
ex.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.

items.en: to enlighten; to explain (a text etc)

ex.zh: 他们的评论很有启发性。
ex.p: tā men de píng lùn hěn yǒu qǐ fā xìng
ex.en: Their comments were illuminating.

ex.zh: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
ex.p: wǒ men de qián bù gòu suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ hǎo bǎ dìng dān qǔ xiāo le
ex.en: I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.

ex.zh: 您决定好要下订单了吗？
ex.p: nín jué dìng hǎo yào xià dìng dān le ma
ex.en: Are you ready to order now?

ex.zh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。
ex.p: tā bèi rén fā xiàn dào zài chú fáng de dì bǎn shàng bù shěng rén shì
ex.en: He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.

ex.zh: 英语是当今世界上一种非常重要的语言。
ex.p: yīng yǔ shì dāng jīn shì jiè shàng yī zhǒng fēi cháng zhòng yào de yǔ yán
ex.en: English is a very important language in today's world.

ex.zh: 他的主意总是可行的。
ex.p: tā de zhǔ yi zǒng shì kě xíng de
ex.en: His ideas are always practical.

items.en: as it turns out; by lucky coincidence

ex.zh: 着火的时候我妈妈恰好在那。
ex.p: zháo huǒ de shí hou wǒ mā ma qià hǎo zài nà
ex.en: My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.

items.en: to show; to take out and show to others

ex.zh: 请出示您的票子。
ex.p: qǐng chū shì nín de piào zǐ
ex.en: Please show your ticket.

ex.zh: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
ex.p: hǎo jǐ jiān xiǎo wū bèi hóng shuǐ gū lì qǐ lai le
ex.en: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.

ex.zh: 许多房屋被洪水冲走了。
ex.p: xǔ duō fáng wū bèi hóng shuǐ chōng zǒu le
ex.en: A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.

items.en: to absorb; to draw (a lesson, insight etc)

sents.p: qū fēn shàn è bù róng yì
sents.en: It isn't easy to distinguish good from evil.

sents.zh: 只凭长相的话很难区分英国人和美国人。
sents.p: zhǐ píng zhǎng xiàng de huà hěn nán qū fēn yīng guó rén hé měi guó rén
sents.en: It's hard to tell Englishmen from Americans just by the way they look.

sents.zh: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。
sents.p: yīng yǔ xiàn yǐ chéng wéi shì jiè shàng xǔ duō guó jiā de tōng yòng yǔ yán le
sents.en: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.

sents.zh: 比起出去钓鱼，我更想待在家里。
sents.p: bǐ qǐ chū qù diào yú wǒ gēng xiǎng dài zài jiā lǐ
sents.en: I'd rather stay home than go fishing.

sents.zh: 前几天人生第一次去钓鱼了。
sents.p: qián jǐ tiān rén shēng dì yī cì qù diào yú le
sents.en: The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.

sents.zh: 我迫切需要冷饮。
sents.p: wǒ pò qiè xū yào lěng yǐn
sents.en: I'm dying for a cold drink.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢跟人打交道。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan gēn rén dǎ jiāo dào
sents.en: I don't like to socialize.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢茶，所以我早餐大致上都喝咖啡。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan chá suǒ yǐ wǒ zǎo cān dà zhì shàng dōu hē kā fēi
sents.en: I do not like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.

sents.zh: 我大致上同意她。
sents.p: wǒ dà zhì shàng tóng yì tā
sents.en: I generally agree with her.

sents.zh: 我会向你展示怎样捕鱼。
sents.p: wǒ huì xiàng nǐ zhǎn shì zěn yàng bǔ yú
sents.en: I'll show you how to catch fish.

sents.zh: 他是个捕鱼好手。
sents.p: tā shì gè bǔ yú hǎo shǒu
sents.en: He is an expert at fishing.

sents.zh: 事情难免会发生。
sents.p: shì qing nán miǎn huì fā shēng
sents.en: Stuff happens.

sents.zh: 日本的人口密度很高。
sents.p: rì běn de rén kǒu mì dù hěn gāo
sents.en: Japan has a high population density.

sents.zh: 他时不时地因为工作去东京。
sents.p: tā shí bù shí de yīn wèi gōng zuò qù dōng jīng
sents.en: He sometimes goes to Tokyo on business.

sents.zh: 我时不时得到母亲的消息。
sents.p: wǒ shí bù shí dé dào mǔ qīn de xiāo xi
sents.en: I hear from my mother once in a while.

sents.zh: 这个房间很拥挤。
sents.p: zhè gè fáng jiān hěn yōng jǐ
sents.en: This room is cramped.

sents.zh: 这本书有精美的插图。
sents.p: zhè běn shū yǒu jīng měi de chā tú
sents.en: This book is beautifully illustrated.

sents.zh: 我知道有些人看重我的工作。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào yǒu xiē rén kàn zhòng wǒ de gōng zuò
sents.en: I know that some people value my work.

items.en: day by day; more and more

ex.zh: 猪肉不适合我。

ex.en: Pork doesn't agree with me.

ex.zh: 为了看野生动物，他去了非洲。

items.en: to fall to the ground; to be set on the ground

ex.zh: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。

ex.en: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.

items.en: to be called; to be known as
to undertake; to accept a contract

ex.zh: 如果你加热冰它就会融化。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ jiā rè bīng tā jiù huì róng huà
ex.en: If you heat ice, it melts.

ex.zh: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。
ex.p: tài yang yī chū lái xuě jiù huì róng huà
ex.en: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.

ex.zh: 你不明白流程。
ex.p: nǐ bù míng bai liú chéng

ex.zh: 他有很多历史书籍。

ex.en: He has a lot of books on history.

ex.zh: 我们喜欢阅读书籍。
ex.p: wǒ men xǐ huan yuè dú shū jí
ex.en: We enjoy reading books.

items.en: to visit and discuss; to interview

ex.zh: 土壤被雨水冲走了。
ex.p: tǔ rǎng bèi yǔ shuǐ chōng zǒu le
ex.en: The rain washed away the soil.

ex.zh: 这是非常好的土壤。
ex.p: zhè shì fēi cháng hǎo de tǔ rǎng
ex.en: This is very good soil.

items.en: to sb's face; in sb's presence

ex.zh: 这个老人一只眼看不见了。
ex.p: zhè gè lǎo rén yī zhǐ yǎn kàn bù jiàn le
ex.en: The old man is blind in one eye.

ex.zh: 我妹妹亲眼看到它了。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei qīn yǎn kàn dào tā le
ex.en: My sister saw it with her own eyes.

ex.zh: 在非洲有许多孩子死于饥饿。
ex.p: zài fēi zhōu yǒu xǔ duō hái zi sǐ yú jī è
ex.en: Many children die of starvation in Africa.

ex.zh: 世界上许多人很饥饿。
ex.p: shì jiè shàng xǔ duō rén hěn jī è
ex.en: A lot of people are starving in the world.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第123单元

Literature

Grammar focus: Excerpts from public-domain modern writers (鲁迅, 朱自清); classical particles 之, 乎, 者, 也

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

units.title: Literature
units.intro: Grammar focus: Excerpts from public-domain modern writers (鲁迅, 朱自清); classical particles 之, 乎, 者, 也

ex.zh: 我想要点蛋糕。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào diǎn dàn gāo
ex.en: I want some cake.

ex.zh: 服务生，我要点菜。
ex.p: fú wù shēng wǒ yào diǎn cài
ex.en: Waiter, I'd like to order.

ex.zh: 交作业的截止日期是下周一。
ex.p: jiāo zuò yè de jié zhǐ rì qī shì xià zhōu yī
ex.en: The homework is due next Monday.

ex.zh: 为了不错过火车，他匆匆赶往了车站。
ex.p: wèi le bù cuò guò huǒ chē tā cōng cōng gǎn wǎng le chē zhàn
ex.en: He hurried to the station so he wouldn't miss the train.

ex.zh: 我匆匆忙忙，为的是能赶上第一班火车。
ex.p: wǒ cōng cōng máng máng wèi de shì néng gǎn shàng dì yī bān huǒ chē
ex.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.

ex.zh: 他的工作是驾驶观光巴士。
ex.p: tā de gōng zuò shì jià shǐ guān guāng bā shì
ex.en: His job is driving a sight-seeing bus.

ex.zh: 舅舅的公司上个月推出了一款新产品。
ex.p: jiù jiu de gōng sī shàng gè yuè tuī chū le yī kuǎn xīn chǎn pǐn
ex.en: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.

ex.zh: 我想和你的舅舅谈一谈。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ de jiù jiu tán yī tán
ex.en: I want to talk to your uncle.

items.en: to be limited to; to be confined to

ex.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
ex.p: chú le gāng qín yǐ wài hái huì wán shén me yuè qì ma
ex.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?

ex.zh: 那个穿棕色大衣的女人是谁？
ex.p: nà gè chuān zōng sè dà yī de nǚ rén shì shéi
ex.en: Who's the woman in the brown coat?

ex.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是棕色。
ex.p: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yán sè shì zōng sè
ex.en: My favorite color is brown.

items.en: to correspond (to); to be equivalent to; to be a

ex.zh: 风暴几个小时没有减弱了。
ex.p: fēng bào jǐ gè xiǎo shí méi yǒu jiǎn ruò le
ex.en: The storm didn't abate for several hours.

ex.zh: 她对绘画有很好的鉴赏力。
ex.p: tā duì huì huà yǒu hěn hǎo de jiàn shǎng lì
ex.en: She's got a good eye for paintings.

ex.zh: 他知道怎么玩棒球。
ex.p: tā zhī dào zěn me wán bàng qiú
ex.en: He knows how to play baseball.

ex.zh: 我看到他在打棒球。
ex.p: wǒ kàn dào tā zài dǎ bàng qiú
ex.en: I saw him playing baseball.

items.en: to age; to deteriorate with age

ex.zh: 没有人能逃过衰老。
ex.p: méi yǒu rén néng táo guò shuāi lǎo
ex.en: No one can escape growing old.

items.en: taken in (by sb's deceit); to be fooled

ex.zh: 它是给容易上当受骗的人的。
ex.p: tā shì gěi róng yì shàng dàng shòu piàn de rén de
ex.en: That's for suckers.

ex.zh: 我不会上当的。
ex.p: wǒ bù huì shàng dàng de
ex.en: I won't be fooled.

ex.zh: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。
ex.p: měi guó guó qí de yán sè shì hóng bái lán
ex.en: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.

ex.zh: 美国国旗有五十颗星。
ex.p: měi guó guó qí yǒu wǔ shí kē xīng
ex.en: The American flag has fifty stars.

ex.zh: 我们在找一个漂亮的屋子住。
ex.p: wǒ men zài zhǎo yī gè piào liang de wū zi zhù
ex.en: We're looking for a nice house to live in.

ex.zh: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。
ex.p: tā què shí hěn piào liang dàn tā hěn zì sī
ex.en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.

ex.zh: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。
ex.p: chéng qiān shàng wàn de rén xiǎng yào zhī dào dá àn
ex.en: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.

ex.zh: 每年有成千上万的外国人访问日本。
ex.p: měi nián yǒu chéng qiān shàng wàn de wài guó rén fǎng wèn rì běn
ex.en: Thousands of foreigners visit Japan every year.

items.en: invoice; receipt or bill for purchase

ex.zh: 我觉得你真是让人大吃一惊。
ex.p: wǒ jué de nǐ zhēn shì ràng rén dà chī yī jīng
ex.en: I think you're really amazing.

ex.zh: 她肯定会大吃一惊的。
ex.p: tā kěn dìng huì dà chī yī jīng de
ex.en: She is certain to be surprised.

ex.zh: 富士山顶盖满了雪。
ex.p: fù shì shān dǐng gài mǎn le xuě
ex.en: The top of Mt. Fuji was covered with snow.

ex.zh: 山顶被雪覆盖了。
ex.p: shān dǐng bèi xuě fù gài le
ex.en: The top of the mountain is covered in snow.

ex.zh: 长发现在过时了。
ex.p: cháng fā xiàn zài guò shí le
ex.en: Long hair is out of fashion now.

ex.zh: 他们的想法太过时了。
ex.p: tā men de xiǎng fǎ tài guò shí le
ex.en: Their way of thinking is behind the times.

sents.zh: 我想要点蛋糕。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào diǎn dàn gāo
sents.en: I want some cake.

sents.zh: 服务生，我要点菜。
sents.p: fú wù shēng wǒ yào diǎn cài
sents.en: Waiter, I'd like to order.

sents.zh: 交作业的截止日期是下周一。
sents.p: jiāo zuò yè de jié zhǐ rì qī shì xià zhōu yī
sents.en: The homework is due next Monday.

sents.zh: 为了不错过火车，他匆匆赶往了车站。
sents.p: wèi le bù cuò guò huǒ chē tā cōng cōng gǎn wǎng le chē zhàn
sents.en: He hurried to the station so he wouldn't miss the train.

sents.zh: 我匆匆忙忙，为的是能赶上第一班火车。
sents.p: wǒ cōng cōng máng máng wèi de shì néng gǎn shàng dì yī bān huǒ chē
sents.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.

sents.zh: 他的工作是驾驶观光巴士。
sents.p: tā de gōng zuò shì jià shǐ guān guāng bā shì
sents.en: His job is driving a sight-seeing bus.

sents.zh: 舅舅的公司上个月推出了一款新产品。
sents.p: jiù jiu de gōng sī shàng gè yuè tuī chū le yī kuǎn xīn chǎn pǐn
sents.en: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.

sents.zh: 我想和你的舅舅谈一谈。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ de jiù jiu tán yī tán
sents.en: I want to talk to your uncle.

sents.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
sents.p: chú le gāng qín yǐ wài hái huì wán shén me yuè qì ma
sents.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?

sents.zh: 那个穿棕色大衣的女人是谁？
sents.p: nà gè chuān zōng sè dà yī de nǚ rén shì shéi
sents.en: Who's the woman in the brown coat?

sents.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是棕色。
sents.p: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yán sè shì zōng sè
sents.en: My favorite color is brown.

sents.zh: 风暴几个小时没有减弱了。
sents.p: fēng bào jǐ gè xiǎo shí méi yǒu jiǎn ruò le
sents.en: The storm didn't abate for several hours.

sents.zh: 她对绘画有很好的鉴赏力。
sents.p: tā duì huì huà yǒu hěn hǎo de jiàn shǎng lì
sents.en: She's got a good eye for paintings.

sents.zh: 他知道怎么玩棒球。
sents.p: tā zhī dào zěn me wán bàng qiú
sents.en: He knows how to play baseball.

sents.zh: 我看到他在打棒球。
sents.p: wǒ kàn dào tā zài dǎ bàng qiú
sents.en: I saw him playing baseball.

sents.zh: 没有人能逃过衰老。
sents.p: méi yǒu rén néng táo guò shuāi lǎo
sents.en: No one can escape growing old.

sents.zh: 它是给容易上当受骗的人的。
sents.p: tā shì gěi róng yì shàng dàng shòu piàn de rén de
sents.en: That's for suckers.

sents.zh: 我不会上当的。
sents.p: wǒ bù huì shàng dàng de
sents.en: I won't be fooled.

sents.zh: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。
sents.p: měi guó guó qí de yán sè shì hóng bái lán
sents.en: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.

sents.zh: 美国国旗有五十颗星。
sents.p: měi guó guó qí yǒu wǔ shí kē xīng
sents.en: The American flag has fifty stars.

sents.zh: 我们在找一个漂亮的屋子住。
sents.p: wǒ men zài zhǎo yī gè piào liang de wū zi zhù
sents.en: We're looking for a nice house to live in.

sents.zh: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。
sents.p: tā què shí hěn piào liang dàn tā hěn zì sī
sents.en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.

sents.zh: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。
sents.p: chéng qiān shàng wàn de rén xiǎng yào zhī dào dá àn
sents.en: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.

sents.zh: 每年有成千上万的外国人访问日本。
sents.p: měi nián yǒu chéng qiān shàng wàn de wài guó rén fǎng wèn rì běn
sents.en: Thousands of foreigners visit Japan every year.

sents.zh: 我觉得你真是让人大吃一惊。
sents.p: wǒ jué de nǐ zhēn shì ràng rén dà chī yī jīng
sents.en: I think you're really amazing.

sents.zh: 她肯定会大吃一惊的。
sents.p: tā kěn dìng huì dà chī yī jīng de
sents.en: She is certain to be surprised.

sents.zh: 富士山顶盖满了雪。
sents.p: fù shì shān dǐng gài mǎn le xuě
sents.en: The top of Mt. Fuji was covered with snow.

sents.zh: 山顶被雪覆盖了。
sents.p: shān dǐng bèi xuě fù gài le
sents.en: The top of the mountain is covered in snow.

sents.zh: 长发现在过时了。
sents.p: cháng fā xiàn zài guò shí le
sents.en: Long hair is out of fashion now.

sents.zh: 他们的想法太过时了。
sents.p: tā men de xiǎng fǎ tài guò shí le
sents.en: Their way of thinking is behind the times.

to feel wronged; to cause sb to feel wronged

items.en: to look as if; to seem

ex.zh: 国家不同，习俗各异。
ex.p: guó jiā bù tóng xí sú gè yì
ex.en: Social customs vary from country to country.

ex.zh: 金子比水重得多。
ex.p: jīn zi bǐ shuǐ zhòng de duō
ex.en: Gold is far heavier than water.

ex.zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

ex.en: I don't mind if the weather is hot.

ex.p: nǐ kǎo lǜ zhōu dào méi yǒu dǎ rǎo wǒ men

items.en: to have a preference for; to fancy

items.en: to enjoy a life in retirement

ex.zh: 面包是面粉做的。
ex.p: miàn bāo shì miàn fěn zuò de

ex.zh: 我知道我的限度。

ex.en: I know my limitations.

items.en: to arrange in order; to emit; to discharge

ex.zh: 我想去滑冰场。

ex.en: I want to go to the skating rink.

second place (in a sports contest); runner-up

sents.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.

sents.zh: 天气热点儿没关系。
sents.p: tiān qì rè diǎn ér méi guān xi
sents.en: I don't mind if the weather is hot.

sents.p: nǐ kǎo lǜ zhōu dào méi yǒu dǎ rǎo wǒ men
sents.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.

sents.zh: 她非常周到和耐心。
sents.p: tā fēi cháng zhōu dào hé nài xīn

sents.zh: 我知道我的限度。

sents.zh: 我想去滑冰场。
